title: Lead – GenAI & AI
description:
**Key Responsibilities -**

* Develop and execute a prioritised AI/GenAI/ Agentic AI road-map linked to measurable outcomes in quality, productivity, cost, delivery, traceability and decision-making.
* Work with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, HR and IT to discover, assess and prioritise use cases.

* **Programming & data:**
  Advanced Python and SQL; data preparation, feature engineering, debugging and code review.
* **GenAI:**
  LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, evaluation, guardrails and agentic workflows.
* **ML & deep learning:**
  scikit-learn/XGBoost or equivalent; PyTorch and/or TensorFlow; validation, imbalance, explainability and model selection.
* **Engineering:**
  Fast API or equivalent, REST APIs, Git, Docker, CI/CD; Kubernetes preferred.
* **Computer vision:**
  OpenCV; classification, detection and segmentation; practical exposure to YOLO or equivalent.
* **MLOps & cloud:**
  MLflow, Azure Machine Learning or equivalent; Azure/AWS/GCP; monitoring and model lifecycle.
* **Time series:**
  Forecasting, anomaly detection and predictive modelling.
* **Industrial integration:**
  ERP/MES concepts, IoT/historians, PLC/SCADA, edge and hybrid deployment exposure preferred

title: Senior Engineer, TSG Software Engineering
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

 

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

This position works as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale browser based or mobile applications developed with current Microsoft development languages and technologies, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

A senior engineer is a senior role in Software Agile delivery team. The person is responsible for managing and executing the complex software modules almost independently. Additionally, the indvidual is responsible of guding and mentoring junior engineers in the team from technology standpoint.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Technical Delivery (75%)**

* Work with teams developing and updating enterprise applications.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Work on tasks supporting the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the technical interdependencies between stories and support Engineering Manager and Product Owner with sequencing.
* Demonstrate working knowledge of business and domain. Supports Engineering Manager and Product Owner in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown, and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule.
* Demonstrate good understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure and suggest improvements to optimize the infrastructure.
* Participate in the design, architecting and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades working with more senior agile team members and Engineering Manager.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components with minimal support from senior team members.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, support unit testing by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills e.g. creating automation tests using selenium, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/ load testing etc. through internal/ external trainings to be a T-Shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Follow Bain development project process and standards in completing committed tasks and modules and contribute to the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write technical documentation as required.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Contribute to the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Help and possibly lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.

**Communication (10%)**

* Ability to present the technical findings and recommendations to the leadership and Software Development team in general.
* Clearly communicates impediments to completing a story and ensures clear understanding of definition of ‘done’.
* Provide input during sprint retrospective to improve team experience.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during cucial conversations.

**Technical mentoring (5%)**

* Provide technical guidance to junior members. Help create a culture of transparency and sustainability.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions,
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Ability to deliver assigned module/ work with much support from senior engineers with Zero D.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills
* Experience developing enterprise scale applications
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated record of T shape behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/ contingencies
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree
* 5-8+ years of relevant experience

  

**Software Engineering - Technical skills:**

* Frameworks: .NET & .NET Core

* Languages: C#, Python, T-SQL
* Web frameworks/ Lib: React, Angular, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* RDBMS: Microsoft SQL Server
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos, etc.
* Vector databases: Azure AI Search, Pinecone, pgvector, etc.
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure Services
* GenAI & ML: Azure OpenAI, LLM integration and prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, embeddings, machine learning model development and deployment
* AI coding assistants: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code
* Search engine: Elasticsearch, Coveo, etc.
* Caching: Redis, MemCache
* Unit testing: XUnit, Jasmine, etc.
* DevOps: GitActions

title: Associate Technical Specialist
description:
**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**
At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.
  
  
As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Associate Technical Specialist is responsible for technical ownership of complex modules, subsystems, and product functionalities. The role translates business requirements into robust technical solutions while driving design quality, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  
  
The Associate Technical Specialist serves as the technical lead within a Scrum team, mentoring engineers and guiding technical decisions to ensure successful product delivery.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in enterprise application development, software architecture, engineering best practices, and technical leadership, with a focus on building scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Technical Design & Ownership**

* Own the design and implementation of complex modules and product subsystems.
* Translate business and functional requirements into detailed technical designs.
* Drive solution architecture decisions within the Scrum team.
* Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, security, and reliability requirements.
* Lead estimation and technical design activities for complex enhancements.

**Technical Leadership & Mentorship**

* Act as one of the go-to technical experts within the Scrum team.
* Mentor Developers and Senior Developers on engineering best practices and design approaches.
* Lead technical discussions, design reviews, and solution evaluations.
* Provide guidance on coding standards, architecture principles, and quality expectations.

**Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex production issues.
* Drive improvements in application performance, maintainability, and system stability.
* Identify technical debt and recommend remediation strategies.
* Proactively identify risks and propose alternative technical approaches.

**Collaboration & Delivery**

* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, QA teams, and Technical Specialists to ensure successful delivery.
* Support technical planning and roadmap discussions at feature and module level.
* Contribute to software releases, deployments, and post-release support activities.
* Ensure engineering deliverables align with established architectural standards.

**Quality & Engineering Excellence**

* Promote adoption of coding standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Drive implementation of code quality best practices.
* Review critical code changes and technical designs.
* Ensure robust technical documentation is maintained.
* Lead and contribute to the development of AI-Driven SDLC use cases.

**Unleash your potential**
To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:
  
  
  

* 7-9 years of software development experience.
* Proven experience in designing and delivering complex enterprise applications.
* Experience leading technical delivery within Agile/Scrum teams.
* Preferably experience in Financial Services or Wealth Management product development.
* Advanced expertise in Java, Spring Framework, Microservices, REST APIs, and database technologies.
* Strong understanding of design patterns, system decomposition, and software architecture principles.
* Experience with performance tuning, scalability, security, and resiliency practices.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps practices, and cloud-native development concepts.
* Advanced troubleshooting and production support capabilities.
* Hands-on experience in efficiently using AI-Powered Tools for AI-assisted development practices.
* Strong technical leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Ability to influence technical decisions within a Scrum team.
* Strong ownership mindset with focus on balancing delivery and technical excellence.
* Proven ability to anticipate risks and drive proactive solutions.

**Education**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA.

**Preferred:**
Experience in developing Artificial Intelligence based products, Generative AI applications, utilities, including Agentic AI.
  
  
**Working at Bravura**
Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.
  
  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme
* Insurance Benefits
* Parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Meals and transportation

**So, what’s next?**
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.

All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

title: ServiceNow HRSD Technical Solution Architect
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As a HRSD Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in the successful implementation, maintenance, and optimization of the ServiceNow HRSD system, ensuring it meets the organization’s needs and drives efficiency and productivity. Your knowledge kit should include a broad technical knowledge and experience across varying infrastructure requirements, development, system architecture and design.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Design and own the end-to-end technical architecture for ServiceNow HRSD implementations, including Employee Center, Case and Knowledge Management, Lifecycle Events, and HR Service Portal.
* Translate business requirements from HR stakeholders into scalable, well-governed technical solutions aligned with ServiceNow best practices.
* Lead solution design workshops, produce architecture documentation (solution designs, integration diagrams, data models), and present recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.
* Define and enforce coding standards, platform governance, and configuration best practices across the HRSD workstream.
* Architect integrations between ServiceNow and third-party/HR systems (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, payroll systems) using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and MID Server.
* Oversee data model design, security architecture (ACLs, data policies, PII handling), and platform scalability considerations specific to HR data.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to developers and configuration analysts within the project team.
* Conduct code and design reviews to ensure solutions meet performance, security, and maintainability standards.
* Support pre-sales and scoping activities, including effort estimation and technical proposal input, where required.
* Stay current with ServiceNow platform releases and HRSD product roadmap, advising on upgrade impacts and new feature adoption.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (including GDPR) in the handling of employee data within the platform.
* What You Bring
* 8+ years of total IT experience with at least total 6+ years of ServiceNow experience, including strong hands-on HRSD experience and solution architecture/technical leadership exposure in complex implementation projects
* Proven experience architecting and delivering at least 2–3 full-cycle HRSD implementations.Strong knowledge of ServiceNow HRSD modules: Employee Case Management, Employee Center Pro, Lifecycle Event Management, Document Management, and Knowledge Management.
* Solid understanding of ServiceNow platform fundamentals: Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Service Portal/UI Builder, ACLs, Business Rules, Script Includes, and CMDB.
* Experience designing integrations with HRIS/payroll systems (SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, or similar).
* Exposure to multi-country/multi-language HR service delivery configurations.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.ServiceNow certifications required: Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist – HRSD.
* Additional certifications preferred: Certified Application Developer (CAD).
* Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken)
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)

title: Lead Architect : Infrastructure
description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Lead Cloud Infrastructure Architect will serve as the senior technical leader for the
**Private Cloud Customers**
. This role is responsible for setting the technical vision, establishing architectural governance, and leading the design and industrialization of next-generation cloud infrastructure offerings.
  
  
The Lead Architect will mentor the team, act as the final authority on complex designs, and bridge technical architecture with strategic business goals.
  
  
**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**I. Strategic Architecture & Governance**

* Define Architecture Strategy: Establish the long-term technical vision and architectural roadmap for the Private Cloud Customers, ensuring alignment with Orange's business objectives.
* Establish Governance: Develop and enforce architectural standards, design patterns, and best practices across all cloud infrastructure projects to ensure security, compliance, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
* Technology Evaluation: Lead the evaluation, selection, and industrialization of new core cloud technologies (e.g., hardware, networking, virtualization, and emerging services like GenAI components).

**II. Technical Solution Leadership**

* Complex Solution Design: Serve as the final design authority for the most complex, high-value cloud and hybrid infrastructure solutions for enterprise customers.
* End-to-End Platform Design: Oversee the architecture and integration of foundational cloud components, including VMware technology (vSphere, NSX-T), Open Source solutions Cisco IP fabric, and multi-vendor hardware (HP, Cisco, Storage, Backup).
* Product Industrialization: Drive the end-to-end industrialization lifecycle for new cloud services, including defining technical specifications, creating service catalogs, and integrating automation, billing, and monitoring systems.

**III. Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Technical Mentorship: Provide guidance, coaching, and technical direction to junior and mid-level architects and engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary technical interface between the Architecture team and Product Management, Operations, Security, and Sales to ensure seamless service delivery.

title: Associate Director – Salesforce & Solution Architecture
description:
**Associate Director – Salesforce & Solution Architecture**

**Location:**
Gurugram, India

**Work Model:**
Hybrid

**Industry:**
Global Enterprise Organization

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced
**Associate Director – Salesforce & Solution Architecture**
to lead enterprise Salesforce architecture, engineering delivery, and platform strategy. This role combines solution architecture and technical leadership with responsibility for delivery governance, engineering standards, and the development of high-performing Salesforce teams.

The successful candidate will translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and integrated technology solutions while providing architectural direction across Salesforce platforms, enterprise applications, APIs, data, and cloud-based services. The role requires a strong blend of Salesforce expertise, enterprise solution design, technical decision-making, and leadership across globally distributed teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Salesforce Solution Architecture & Technical Strategy

* Define and govern end-to-end Salesforce solution architectures aligned with enterprise technology strategy and business objectives.
* Translate business requirements into scalable technical designs, architecture blueprints, integration patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
* Provide architectural guidance across Salesforce configuration, Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flows, data models, and platform extensions.
* Evaluate architectural options, technology frameworks, and design trade-offs to ensure scalability, maintainability, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Establish architecture principles, design standards, reusable components, and technical governance across Salesforce initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for platform modernization, automation, AI enablement, and continuous improvement.

2. Salesforce Engineering & Delivery Leadership

* Lead end-to-end Salesforce engineering delivery, ensuring projects meet agreed scope, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Oversee solution design, development, integrations, testing, deployment, and production readiness.
* Guide engineering teams on technical design decisions, coding standards, code quality, performance optimization, and engineering best practices.
* Drive Agile delivery, sprint planning, backlog prioritization, release planning, and execution governance.
* Monitor delivery KPIs, resolve technical blockers, manage dependencies, and mitigate delivery risks.
* Ensure effective CI/CD, environment management, and deployment practices using tools such as Copado, Gearset, and Git-based workflows.

3. Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture

* Design and govern integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems using APIs, middleware, and established integration patterns.
* Provide architectural oversight for data migration, data quality, data models, synchronization, and platform interoperability.
* Ensure Salesforce solutions integrate effectively with enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and downstream business systems.
* Define integration standards, data governance practices, and technical controls to support reliable and secure information exchange.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and technology leaders to ensure consistency with broader enterprise architecture.

4. Team Leadership & Capability Development

* Lead, mentor, and develop Salesforce architects, developers, administrators, QA engineers, and technical leads.
* Build high-performing engineering teams with clear ownership, accountability, and delivery expectations.
* Establish technical development plans, mentoring practices, and knowledge-sharing forums.
* Support workforce planning, resource allocation, performance management, and capability development.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

5. Stakeholder & Business Partnership

* Partner with product owners, business stakeholders, enterprise architects, and senior technology leaders to shape solution direction and delivery priorities.
* Explain architectural options, technical risks, dependencies, and investment trade-offs to business and executive stakeholders.
* Align technical roadmaps with business strategy, operational needs, and long-term platform objectives.
* Coordinate across cross-functional and globally distributed teams to drive consistent architectural decisions and delivery outcomes.
* Support estimation, resource planning, prioritization, and technology investment decisions.

6. Platform Governance, Security & Quality

* Ensure Salesforce solutions comply with enterprise architecture standards, security policies, privacy requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Oversee architecture reviews, technical risk assessments, testing strategy, regression testing, and UAT readiness.
* Establish governance for platform configuration, access controls, change management, releases, and production deployments.
* Drive platform reliability, scalability, performance, technical debt reduction, and operational excellence.
* Maintain architecture documentation, technical standards, implementation guidelines, and continuous improvement plans.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in technology delivery, solution architecture, Salesforce engineering, or technical leadership, with substantial Salesforce experience.
* Proven experience designing and governing enterprise Salesforce solutions across complex business and technology environments.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, platform capabilities, configuration, development lifecycle, and implementation best practices.
* Working knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flows, APIs, integrations, and Salesforce data architecture.
* Experience leading technical teams, architects, developers, and QA resources across multiple projects or workstreams.
* Demonstrated expertise in solution design, architecture governance, Agile delivery, release management, and engineering quality.
* Familiarity with Salesforce DevOps practices and tools such as Copado, Gearset, and Git-based CI/CD workflows.
* Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, data migration, cloud platforms, security, and access governance.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant Salesforce certifications, such as Application Architect, System Architect, or other advanced Salesforce credentials.
* Experience with large-scale enterprise Salesforce implementations and multi-cloud environments.
* Exposure to enterprise architecture frameworks, API-led integration, automated testing, and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience with platform modernization, AI-enabled solutions, or emerging Salesforce capabilities.
* Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams and enterprise stakeholders.

**Key Success Factors**

* Scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solution architecture.
* Consistent, high-quality engineering delivery and predictable releases.
* Effective integration across Salesforce and enterprise technology platforms.
* Strong technical governance, engineering standards, and reduced technical debt.
* High-performing teams with clear technical ownership and accountability.
* Alignment between business strategy, architecture roadmaps, and technology execution.

title: Server Performance Architect - Hardware
description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
  
  
NVIDIA is seeking architects to drive architectural performance for its next-generation AI server systems. This position demands a unique capability to bridge deep architectural knowledge, workload analysis, and hands-on silicon investigations. Candidates should be adept at working directly with silicon, high-level models, and simulators. Responsibilities include conducting performance investigations on both NVIDIA and competitive platforms, and developing targeted microbenchmarks to examine specific architectural aspects. The role does not heavily involve modeling tasks (functional or performance), though occasional focused assignments may arise.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Defining and driving server-level performance targets across CPU, GPU, memory, interconnect, networking, and storage subsystems
* Conducting hands-on workload characterisation and bottleneck analysis on NVIDIA and competitive server platforms using AI training, inference, and HPC benchmarks
* Leveraging profiling, tracing, and analysis tools to root-cause performance issues and identify optimisation opportunities at the system level
* Performing trade-off studies on system topology, thermal/power envelopes, and memory hierarchy to guide architectural decisions
* Collaborating with silicon, platform, firmware, and software teams to identify and close performance gaps from bring-up through production
* Developing automation and tooling for performance regression tracking and reporting
* Representing the performance perspective in architecture reviews and cross-functional design discussions
* Building and maintaining analytical performance models and simulation frameworks for next-generation server platforms
* Publishing internal performance studies and best-practice guides for partner and customer enablement

**What We Need To See**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of experience in server/system performance architecture or related disciplines
* Deep understanding of modern server architectures — CPU microarchitecture, PCIe/CXL, DDR/HBM memory subsystems, and coherency protocols
* Strong hands-on experience with system-level profiling and performance analysis tools on server platform(s)
* Solid knowledge of GPU-accelerated compute, high-performance networking, or high-performance storage subsystems
* Proficiency in Python, C/C++, or similar languages for scripting, data analysis, and tool development
* Comfortable and proficient using AI-powered coding and productivity tools to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation workflows
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to distil complex performance data into actionable architectural recommendations

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience with AI/ML training and inference workloads at data-centre scale
* Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (Hopper, Blackwell, Rubin) and associated software stacks (CUDA, NCCL)
* Background in chip-to-chip interconnect performance analysis (C2C, UCIe)
* Exposure to power/thermal-aware performance optimisation techniques
* Track record of contributions to industry conferences or published performance studies

description:

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll work as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. Team members work collaboratively to design, build, and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives. Systems developed are primarily enterprise-scale, browser-based or mobile applications, built with modern technology stacks and increasingly with AI-assisted and agent-assisted development, with a global user base and integration points with one or more other internal Bain systems.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

The Staff Engineer I is a senior individual contributor role that reports to the Engineering Manager. The role can independently handle a software module/function, which includes technical delivery, stakeholder management, and communication, and is accountable for the delivery outcomes of the wider team. The role is also responsible for aligning the technical delivery goals with product vision. The individual is also responsible for role modeling, and for coaching and mentoring of the team from a technical delivery standpoint.

  

**Technical Delivery (75%)**

* Provide module-level technical leadership on teams developing and updating enterprise-scale applications at Bain, and help drive the overall delivery outcomes of the team.
* Work as a member of an agile software development team with full participation in all Agile team events and activities.
* Take lead for the development of more complex components or functions with special requirements within a sprint. Understand the links between stories and desired outcomes and support the Engineering Manager and Product Owner with product strategy.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of business and domain. Support Product Owner and Engineering Manager in defining product roadmap and backlog by providing technical input.
* Work in collaboration with other team members on an agile team to analyze user stories, perform task breakdown, and define technical approach and complete committed tasks as per sprint schedule. Support junior team members in analyzing requirements and completion of technical tasks.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of using the underlying application development infrastructure.
* Help improve the infrastructure to optimize the application development.
* Contribute in the design, architecting, and prototyping of applications and significant application upgrades, primarily working with Engineering Managers, Architects, and Project/Product Managers.
* Apply AI-assisted development tools and AI agents responsibly to improve team productivity and code quality, and set the standard for how the team uses them.
* Champion secure software development practices, including secure use of AI-generated code, review of AI output, and protection of data and prompts.
* Own both development and testing: create the end-to-end test plan, execute it, and ensure zero-defect delivery.
* Prepare work estimates for committed components and support/review other team members’ estimates. Actively make recommendations to the other team members for their task allocations to promote skill diversity and growth.
* Write unit test plans for committed components. Execute and confirm successful completion of unit tests as part of the criteria for completion. In addition, review and support unit testing completed by other team members.
* Contribute to planning and participate in the testing and release of application releases.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support, and database administration.
* Demonstrate ability to acquire new skills, e.g. creating automation tests, creating UX designs, DevOps, performing functional/load testing, etc., through internal/external trainings to be a T-shaped team member helping the team in achieving sprint goals.
* Help ensure adherence to Bain development project process and standards within the agile team as well as actively participating in the continual evolution of processes and standards.
* Write and review technical documentation prepared by the team.

**Research (10%)**

* Contribute to evaluating and employing new and/or supplemental technologies necessary to deliver functionality for a given software application.
* Actively promote the research and evaluation of new tools and technologies, especially in Gen AI, LLMs, and AI agents, beyond current product requirements that are likely to be used in future initiatives. Lead the presentation of findings and recommendations to the full Software Development team

  

**Communication (10%)**

* Clearly communicate and exchange ideas across multiple fronts, e.g., design, technical solutions.
* Demonstrate assertion in communication while working with team and stakeholders during crucial conversations.
* Has strong listening skills to recognize needs of a team-member, and acts to deliver a great team experience.
* Participate in internal skill development by sharing concepts and technologies with the full Software Development team.
* Provide feedback to Scrum Master, Engineering Manager, and Product Owner to improve team performance.
* Shares best practices across software group.

  

**Mentoring (5%)**

* Provide day to day technical guidance and mentoring to 1-3 less experienced engineers on the agile team.

  

**ABOUT YOU**

* 8–12 years in software engineering, including 2–3 years of technical leadership experience in owning complex modules, driving architecture decisions, and mentoring developers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of agile software development methodologies and processes.
* Understanding of core architecture of the product and ability to suggest new technologies and approaches as per the product vision.
* Ability to deliver the assigned work independently with zero defects.
* Demonstrated record of strong performance in prior software development positions.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills.
* Experience developing enterprise-scale applications.
* Demonstrated record of T-shaped behavior to expedite delivery by managing conflicts/contingencies.
* Experience providing technical leadership to a group of developers.
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

  

**Software Engineering – Technical Skills**

* AI and Gen AI: understanding of large language models (capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns), Gen AI application development, prompt engineering, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vectors, vector databases, machine learning fundamentals
* Secure development: secure software development practices, including for AI-driven development
* Backend languages and frameworks: Python, .NET and .NET Core, Java, or equivalent; C#, T-SQL, etc.
* Web frameworks/libraries: Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, etc.
* Architecture: scalable, secure, and maintainable system design; microservices, API design, and cloud-native patterns

* Cloud: Microsoft Azure services or equivalent

title: Staff Engineer - Salesforce/ nCino
description:
**About Us**
At OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower ambitious businesses and the communities they serve. Since 2015, we've lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while driving economic growth in the markets we serve.
  
  
**About The Role**
nCino on Salesforce is the platform our lending teams use to originate, approve and manage commercial loans in the UK and US. As Staff Engineer you will be the technical lead for the Salesforce / nCino engineering team in Gurugram. You will own the technical direction of the platform, lead the team's most complex work hands-on, and be the main engineering contact for Lending, Credit and CRM stakeholders.
  
  
What you'll work on
  
  

* Integration modernisation: Lead the move of nCino integrations with our core lending platform off MuleSoft onto direct, well-tested integrations, and retire the old flows safely.
* Platform upgrades: Plan and lead nCino release upgrades across the team, including impact analysis, regression testing and rollout.
* Production support: Own production stability for the lending platform. Lead incident response, root-cause analysis and fixes so loans keep booking without disruption.
* Regulatory change: Deliver regulatory changes in nCino, such as Basel 3.1 requirements, with the audit trail and change control a regulated bank needs.
* Integrations: Design and build integrations between nCino and our CRM, customer portal, customer due diligence (KYC) and credit bureau services, including via our data warehouse.
* Data privacy and access: Lead data privacy work such as record anonymisation, and standardise access rights and the security model across the org.
* Standard features first: Enable standard nCino features (for example product packages) instead of building custom code, and reduce existing customisation where possible.
* Test automation and delivery: Work with QA to grow automated test coverage and improve CI/CD for Salesforce deployments.
* Documentation and debt: Keep technical documentation current, and tidy up technical debt and deprecated components.

What you should know
  
  

* 12+ years of Salesforce engineering experience, including at least 3 years on nCino (Commercial Banking / Loan Origination) or a similar lending platform built on Salesforce
* Deep hands-on skills in Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Flows and Platform Events, and a clear view of when to use configuration and when to use code
* Strong knowledge of the nCino data model and features: relationships, loans, product packages, covenants, collateral and the loan lifecycle
* Integration design experience: REST/SOAP APIs, middleware such as MuleSoft, event-driven patterns, Named Credentials and OAuth, plus error handling and reconciliation between systems
* Salesforce security model: profiles, permission sets, sharing rules and field-level security, and how to design these for least privilege
* Salesforce DX, source control (GitHub), automated testing and CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce (e.g. SFDX, Gearset or Copado)
* Experience planning and running managed-package upgrades with minimal disruption to users
* Experience working in a regulated environment, such as a bank or financial services firm, with change control, auditability and data protection (GDPR)
* Proven technical leadership: setting standards, reviewing code, mentoring engineers, breaking down and estimating work, and making sound trade-offs
* Clear communicator who can work directly with Lending, Credit and Product stakeholders across UK, US and India time zones

Nice to have
  
  

* Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer II, Application Architect, Integration Architect) and nCino certifications
* Understanding of commercial lending products and processes, including syndicated lending
* Experience with data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery) and moving data between Salesforce and other systems
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day engineering

Tech
  
  
We're pragmatic about our technology choices. These are some of the things we use at the moment:
  
  

* Salesforce Platform, nCino
* Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flows, Platform Events
* Salesforce DX, GitHub, CI/CD
* MuleSoft (being retired), REST APIs, Python and NodeJS services
* PostgreSQL, BigQuery
* AWS, GCP
* incident.io, Jira

Work Culture
  
  
We expect you to work in these ways, as well as encouraging and enabling these practices from others:
  
  

* Collaborate - We work in cross-functional, mission driven, autonomous squads that gel over time. We pair program to work better through shared experience and knowledge.
* Focus on outcomes over outputs - Solving a problem for users that translates to business results is our goal. Measurements focused on that goal help us to understand if we are succeeding.
* Practice continuous improvement - We optimize for feedback now, rather than presume what might be needed in the future and introduce complexity before it will be used. We share learnings in blame-free formats, so that we do not repeat things that have failed, but still have confidence to innovate.
* Seek to understand our users - We constantly seek understanding from data and conversations to better serve our users' needs.
* Test outside-in, test first - TDD keeps us confident in moving fast and deploying regularly. We write scenarios first, coupling tests to behavior rather than implementation.
* You build it, you run it - We embrace DevOps culture and end-to-end ownership of products and features. Every engineer has the opportunity to lead delivery of features from start to finish.
* Embrace difference - No egos - people listen to and learn from others at all levels, with strong opinions held loosely. A wide range of voices heard to the benefit of all.

**What We Offer**

* Health & Protection: Medical cover for you, your family & parents; life and accidental cover at a multiple of your salary
* Wellbeing: Annual health check-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and an Employee Assistance Programme — all sponsored
* Time Off: Earned, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity & paternity leave
* Life Milestones: A financial gesture of support at marriage, childbirth, and bereavement
* Flexible Benefits: Tax-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave & travel, and NPS
* Growth: Professional certification support, learning & development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days
* Our Workplace: Modern central offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee — we work hard to build a culture worth showing up for

**Ideal candidate profile?**

* 11–15 years of software engineering experience, with at least 8+ years focused on iOS application development.
* Proven experience building and launching products from
  **0 to 1**
  in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong background in consumer internet (
  **B2C**
  ) products serving large user bases.
* Deep expertise in
  **Swift**
  , iOS SDK, UIKit, and modern iOS development frameworks.
* Strong understanding of software architecture patterns such as MVVM, Clean Architecture, Modular Architecture, and Dependency Injection.
* Experience designing systems that handle scale, high availability, and performance optimization.

* Proven ability to influence engineering direction across teams and organizations.
* Experience scaling mobile products to millions of users.
* Exposure to SwiftUI and modern Apple ecosystem technologies.

* Track record of driving major platform migrations or architectural transformations.
* Experience working in high-growth startups or rapidly scaling technology companies.
* Contributions to open-source projects, engineering blogs, patents, or technical conferences are a plus.

**Why This Role?**

* A fast, agile culture where releases ship quickly and your judgment drives the roadmap.

**WITH THE RIGHT TEAM, ANYTHING IS POSSIBLE.**

If you're looking for an environment that's fun and friendly but incredibly fast-paced; a place where we measure the time between releases in days; a place where our focus begins and ends at the consumer, we'd love to have you!

**JOIN US!**

title: Splunk Security Architect - Professional Services
description:
**Meet the Team**
At Splunk and Cisco, we believe in turning data into answers. We are a team of passionate innovators in the Customer Success & Experience organization, committed to our customers’ success, our product’s evolution, and, most importantly, each other’s growth. Together, we help clients navigate the complex landscape of modern cyber defense and redefine how the world interacts with machine data.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Professional Services Architect (Security), you will be the technical and strategic authority for our Security portfolio and a Trusted Advisor to our customers. You will architect solutions across our SIEM and SOAR ecosystems, including Splunk Enterprise Security, UEBA, and SOAR. You aren’t just deploying software; you are architecting outcomes that protect organizations from the next generation of threats, with the opportunity to take ownership of your work, learn from industry leaders, and play a vital role in a team that celebrates collective success. This role requires regional travel of up to 30%.
  
  

* Architect Complex Solutions: Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of security deployments, from initial strategy and integration to ongoing optimization.
* Drive Innovation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to influence product roadmaps and develop new strategies that redefine how customers monitor their infrastructure.
* Act as a Trusted Advisor: Engage at all levels, from C-suite stakeholders to technical engineers, to ensure operational success and strategic alignment.
* Empower the Customer: Enable client teams to manage, scale, and solve complex security challenges independently.
* Foster Growth: Champion a culture of continuous improvement, mentoring team members and contributing to a collaborative, high-performance environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), security consulting, or security sales engineering.
* Proven success implementing and architecting SIEM software.
* Strong background in Cloud IaaS (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and 3+ years of experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes and Docker).
* Proficiency in at least two of the following: Python, Java, .NET, PHP, Ruby, Node.JS, Objective-C; comfortable working across both Unix and Windows command lines.
* Experience with automation/orchestration tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef, or Terraform).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A high sense of urgency and the ability to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical problems into business-value conversations.
* A self-starter mindset with a passion for continuous learning and professional development.
* Experience creating technical documentation (architecture diagrams, white papers, etc.).
* Bonus: Knowledge of Splunk administration or statistical and analytical modeling.

These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

title: Founding Member, Senior Innovation Engineer (Delhi NCR - Hybrid)
description:
**Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?**

J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.

The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enable clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.

**Job Description**

The Innovation Engineer rapidly turns high-value business opportunities into working Digital & AI solutions. This hands-on role designs, builds, integrates, and tests prototypes, agents, workflows, automations, and applications that can be evaluated with real users before the firm commits to larger-scale investment.

Working closely with Digital Solution Consultants, business subject-matter experts, and enterprise technology partners, the Innovation Engineer owns the technical execution of individual Foundry initiatives, from technical discovery and architecture through prototype development, iteration, feasibility validation, and transition planning. The role balances speed with sound engineering judgment and helps determine whether a concept can be delivered securely, responsibly, and at the appropriate level of scale.

This position also represents a unique opportunity to join as a founding member of our new Digital Innovation Foundry hub in New Delhi. As one of the hub's earliest team members, the Innovation Engineer will have the opportunity to help establish how the team operates, collaborates, and delivers innovative solutions while contributing to the growth of a new strategic capability for the firm.

J.S. Held is continuing to define the development technology stack, cloud patterns, environments, and CI/CD capabilities needed to support innovation at scale. As an early member of the Digital Innovation Foundry, the Innovation Engineer will partner closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, and other technology teams to help shape practical standards, reusable patterns, development environments, and delivery practices. The role requires a builder mindset, strong cloud development experience, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to distinguish rapid experimentation from production-ready engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Rapid Prototyping & Solution Development**

* Build functional prototypes, proofs of concept, agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and lightweight applications that allow opportunities to be tested with real users.
* Translate business problems, user journeys, requirements, and acceptance criteria into practical technical solutions in close partnership with Digital Solution Consultants.
* Use rapid, iterative development methods to incorporate user feedback and improve functionality, reliability, and usability.
* Select fit-for-purpose technologies and patterns for each experiment while considering speed, security, supportability, reuse, and the likely path to scale.
* Document technical assumptions, architecture decisions, dependencies, known limitations, and lessons learned so that decisions are transparent and reusable.
* Demonstrate working solutions to business and technical stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs in clear, decision-oriented language.

**AI, Agents & Automation Engineering**

* Design and build AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Azure services, and other approved technologies.
* Develop and evaluate AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation patterns, prompt and orchestration logic, knowledge grounding, tool use, workflow automation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Integrate solutions with enterprise data, content, APIs, applications, and identity services while following approved access and security patterns.
* Evaluate solution quality, grounding, accuracy, reliability, performance, cost, and failure modes using test cases appropriate to the use case.
* Build reusable components, connectors, templates, and patterns where they can accelerate multiple initiatives and reduce fragmented point solutions.
* Identify when a low-code, configuration-based, custom-development, or existing-platform approach is most appropriate.

**Cloud, Architecture & Technical Feasibility**

* Design and develop cloud-based solutions in Microsoft Azure.
* Conduct technical discovery and feasibility assessment covering architecture, data, integrations, identity and access, security, privacy, performance, scalability, observability, support, and cost.
* Partner with IT and Enterprise Architecture to define appropriate solution patterns and clarify the boundary between rapid Foundry experimentation and enterprise production delivery.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and constraints early and recommend whether an initiative should proceed, be redesigned, transition to an enterprise team, or stop.
* Contribute technical estimates and delivery options to initiative-level business cases and scale decisions.
* Ensure prototypes use representative data responsibly and do not create unsupported production dependencies or unmanaged technical risk.

**Engineering Foundations & Delivery Practices**

* Partner with IT to help establish the development technology stack, source-control approach, environments, infrastructure patterns, deployment methods, and engineering guardrails for the Foundry.
* Help define and mature CI/CD practices for prototypes and solutions, recognizing that these capabilities are still being established rather than assuming mature pipelines already exist.
* Apply sound software engineering practices including modular design, version control, code review, automated testing, documentation, dependency management, secrets management, and secure configuration.
* Work with IT to define practical development, test, quality-assurance, and production pathways appropriate to solution complexity and risk.
* Implement monitoring, logging, usage telemetry, and cost visibility where appropriate to support evaluation and future supportability.
* Prepare validated solutions for transition by documenting architecture, code, configuration, data flows, deployment needs, operational requirements, and known risks.

**Collaboration, Reuse & Scale**

* Work closely with Digital Solution Consultants and business users throughout discovery, piloting, testing, and iteration rather than treating development as a downstream handoff.
* Collaborate with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Legal, Compliance, and other partners to incorporate enterprise requirements at the appropriate stage.
* Provide initiative-level technical progress, feasibility findings, risks, cost considerations, and recommendations to support portfolio reviews and investment decisions.
* Contribute reusable technical standards, reference implementations, templates, and playbooks to strengthen the Foundry operating model.
* Mentor non-engineering team members on technical possibilities, constraints, and responsible experimentation, and support knowledge transfer to teams that assume ownership of successful solutions.
* · Stay current on relevant AI, cloud, automation, and development capabilities, and evaluate emerging tools based on business fit rather than novelty.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud application development, solution engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering, or a related field, including hands-on responsibility for designing and delivering working solutions.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience developing AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Azure AI services, or closely comparable enterprise platforms.
* Strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Python, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript, with experience building APIs, services, integrations, and user-facing applications.
* Hands-on cloud development experience in Microsoft Azure is required; experience across multiple cloud providers, including Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud, is strongly preferred.
* Experience with cloud architecture, APIs, event-driven or serverless patterns, identity and access management, data stores, enterprise integrations, monitoring, and secure application design.
* Experience with AI application patterns such as agents, retrieval-augmented generation, model and prompt orchestration, grounding, evaluation, tool use, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Experience establishing or improving development foundations, including source control, branching, automated testing, environments, infrastructure as code, deployment automation, and CI/CD practices.
* Ability to prototype rapidly while making clear distinctions between experimental code and production-ready solutions, including the risks and work required to transition between them.
* · Working knowledge of security, privacy, responsible AI, data governance, resiliency, performance, cost management, observability, and production support considerations.
* · Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain architecture choices and technical trade-offs to business leaders, subject-matter experts, architects, engineers, and risk partners.
* · Experience in professional services, consulting, or another expert-led, knowledge-intensive environment is beneficial.
* · Self-directed builder mindset with the ability to create structure in an evolving environment, partner constructively with enterprise IT, and balance delivery speed with reusable and supportable engineering practices

**Additional Information**

We welcome applications from individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable adjustment in relation to any of the above, please email jobs@jsheld.com and include “Applicant Adjustment” within the subject line with your request and contact information.

**Some of the Benefits We Have Include**

J.S. Held understands all of our employees are people and sometimes life needs flexibility. We work to always provide an environment that best supports and suits our team’s needs.

* Our flexible work environment allows employees to work remotely when needed
* Comprehensive Medical Insurance

**Other Duties**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read the J.S. Held Online Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as required and described therein.

Please explore what we’re all about at www.jsheld.com.

**EEO and Job Accommodations**

*We embrace diversity and our commitment to building a team and environment that fosters professional and personal enrichment is unwavering. We are greater when we are equal!*

*J.S. Held is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to hiring a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
  
  
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
  
  
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.
  
  
To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.
  
  
OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy
  
  
At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.
