title: Software Development Engineer, Payroll Tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
  
  
The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume + complex business rules in a highly distributed and service-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
  
  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
  
  
**A Day In The Life**
You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own design, development, unit test and integration test of features and modules.
* Operational maintenance in production environment.
* Code reviews, design reviews, HLD/LLD preparation.
* Participate in requirements grooming sessions.
* Suggest new ways to improve the customer experience or product.
* Responsible for CI/CD pipelines and suggest ways to improve the code delivery process.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Because the software we build is closely tied to the performance of the firm's investments and to its day-to-day operations, the work done by these teams is highly critical and impactful.

You will execute individual projects and deliverables while collaborating with business groups, driving complete project lifecycles from collecting and analyzing requirements through design, implementation, deployment, and production support. You will work closely with a broad set of stakeholders, translating their needs into well-reasoned technical proposals and carrying those proposals through to delivery while holding a high bar for both quality and timelines. You will also perform R&D to evaluate the appropriate technologies to use and resolve application and data issues in production within timelines. title: Co-founder & Chief Technology Officer
description:
**Co-founder & CTO, NinjaHelp**
NinjaHelp helps Indian families find trusted, verified help for their homes: elder-care attendants, nannies and cooks. Saathi by NinjaHelp gives workers better jobs, at zero cost to them. a live platform (Postgres/Supabase, TypeScript, Vercel), a WhatsApp channel for workers, and engineers already shipping. You decide what stays and what gets rebuilt.

apply here, or write to info@mondoviatech.com about the hardest system you’ve built and why this problem interests you.

You will provide guidance on technical strategy, design the overall technology architecture and mentor and coach the technical team as you implement capabilities to solve sophisticated business problems, deploy innovative products, services and experiences to delight our customers! * Demonstrated knowledge of agentic AI concepts and frameworks, with the ability to design, guide, and implement AI-driven solutions that leverage autonomous agents to enhance business and technology outcomes.
* Expertise in Cloud technologies and current industry tools and languages - primarily AWS capabilities, Postgres, Redshift, Java, Python, C++, ETL, Power BI, and both transactional and analytical data structures.
* Strong Data Engineering and Data Analysis skillsets. Work with development and data teams to design and develop efficient, effective data solutions to enable robust end-user self-service.

* Ability to lead and effectively leverage diverse ideas, experiences, thoughts and perspectives to the benefit of the organization
* Experience with agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
* Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business
* Ability to learn new skills and knowledge on an on-going basis through self-initiative and tackling challenges

title: Principal Engineer
description:
****About Payoneer****
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
Principal Engineer – Backend
  
  
****About Payoneer****
Payoneer empowers businesses, professionals, and enterprises to participate in the global economy by enabling seamless cross-border payments and financial services. Our technology powers critical financial workflows at global scale, with a strong focus on reliability, security, scalability, and innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Principal Engineer – Backend to provide technical leadership across Payoneer's backend engineering organization and help shape the next generation of our distributed financial systems.
  
  
This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture with strong product thinking and organizational influence.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer, you will work on some of Payoneer's most complex technical challenges, define architectural direction, drive engineering excellence, and enable multiple teams to build reliable, scalable, and resilient systems.
  
  
The role also requires an AI-first mindset in identifying opportunities to use AI and agentic technologies to improve how we build, operate, and evolve our products and engineering systems. You will also help explore and build systems using emerging protocols and technologies such as MCP (Model Context Protocol).
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Define and drive the technical and architectural vision for large-scale backend systems and distributed platforms.
* Design and build highly scalable, resilient, secure, and fault-tolerant distributed systems supporting Payoneer's global financial infrastructure.
* Solve complex technical problems spanning multiple systems, services, teams, and domains.
* Drive architectural decisions and establish engineering patterns, standards, and best practices across teams.
* Lead the evolution of backend platforms toward greater scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and developer productivity.
* Act as a technical leader and trusted advisor to engineering leadership, product leaders, and other stakeholders.
* Work closely with engineering teams to identify and address systemic technical challenges and technical debt.
* Champion an AI-first approach to software engineering, identifying opportunities to leverage LLMs, AI agents, automation, and intelligent developer tooling across the software development lifecycle.
* Explore, prototype, and drive adoption of emerging AI technologies, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-based architectures, where they can create meaningful business or engineering value.
* Partner with teams across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, data, and other functions to solve complex cross-domain problems.
* Influence technical strategy across multiple engineering teams and organizational boundaries, without relying solely on direct authority.
* Mentor and coach engineering leads, senior engineers, and architects, helping raise the technical bar across the organization.
* Help develop the next generation of technical leaders through architecture reviews, design discussions, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing.
* Establish and promote practices around engineering excellence, system design, reliability, security, testing, observability, and operational readiness.
* Lead technical initiatives that require coordination across geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and continuously evaluate how they can improve Payoneer's engineering capabilities.

****What We're Looking For****

* Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and backend platforms.
* Strong expertise in backend engineering, system architecture, APIs, microservices, data-intensive systems, and cloud-native architectures.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including consistency, availability, fault tolerance, concurrency, distributed transactions, messaging, event-driven architectures, and scalability.
* Proven experience leading architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams or complex technology domains.
* Strong track record of taking ambiguous, complex problems and translating them into scalable technical solutions.
* Experience operating systems at significant scale with strong requirements around availability, performance, security, and reliability.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, observability, production operations, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with AI/LLM technologies and a demonstrated interest in building AI-first engineering systems and workflows.
* Familiarity with AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, agentic workflows, or similar emerging AI technologies is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence engineering and product decisions across organizational boundaries.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers, tech leads, and technical leaders.
* Strong product mindset and the ability to balance technical excellence with business outcomes.
* Comfortable working in a globally distributed, cross-functional engineering environment.

****What Success Looks Like****
In this role, success means having an impact beyond the systems you directly build.
  
  
**You Will:**

* Shape the architecture and technical direction of critical Payoneer platforms.
* Enable multiple engineering teams to build and operate better distributed systems.
* Raise the technical bar through mentorship, architecture leadership, and engineering practices.
* Help Payoneer adopt an AI-first engineering culture and identify high-value opportunities for AI and agentic technologies.
* Drive successful adoption of emerging technologies such as MCP where appropriate.
* Improve the scalability, reliability, security, and efficiency of our platforms.
* Become a trusted technical partner to engineering, product, and business leadership.

**Why This Role**
The Principal Engineer role provides an opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology, architecture, product, and organizational leadership.
  
  
You will work on complex problems at global scale, influence technology strategy across teams, mentor the next generation of engineering leaders, and help shape how Payoneer builds software in an increasingly AI-first world.
  
  
**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
****Build Each Other Up****
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is India’s leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15,000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1.5B+ customer conversations, we’re building the operating system for commerce growth.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to build and scale the core backend platform that powers merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and integrations with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and WooCommerce.
  
  
The role involves designing reliable, scalable backend services, making architectural decisions, and improving the performance and operational efficiency of production systems. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to build reusable platform capabilities, reduce manual interventions, and support the growing needs of merchants. You will also contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the development of other engineers on the team.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Backend Platform Development: Design, develop, and maintain core backend services and reusable platform capabilities for merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and external integrations.
* System Design and Architecture: Own low-level and high-level designs for shared services. Make decisions around APIs, data models, failure handling, performance, scalability, and maintainability, and document design decisions clearly.
* Distributed Systems and Kafka: Design and operate event-driven systems using Kafka, including topic and partition strategies, consumer groups, message ordering, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, consumer lag monitoring, and schema evolution.
* System Performance and Optimisation: Improve SQL query performance, caching, queuing, and service efficiency. Investigate production bottlenecks and implement solutions that address root causes.
* Platform Integrations and Data Synchronisation: Build reliable, bi-directional integrations with eCommerce platforms and external systems. Use patterns such as outbox, change data capture (CDC), reconciliation jobs, and backfills while accounting for third-party API rate limits.
* Scalability and Multi-Tenant Architecture: Design systems that support multiple merchants reliably, including data partitioning and sharding, workload isolation, backpressure management, and appropriate consistency models.
* Production Reliability and Observability: Own production reliability through on-call support, incident response, root-cause analysis, postmortems, and service-level objectives (SLOs). Use observability and application performance monitoring tools, including SigNoz, to identify and resolve issues.
* Infrastructure and Cost Optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, manual support work, and recurring merchant-specific fixes without compromising system reliability or delivery speed.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to plan delivery, communicate technical decisions and risks, review designs, and manage production priorities.
* Technical Leadership: Lead design reviews, establish engineering standards, review critical changes, and mentor SDE I and SDE II engineers. Contribute to technical direction across teams and promote clear documentation and execution practices.
* AI Systems and Engineering Tools: Apply AI-assisted development tools where appropriate and demonstrate an understanding of AI system design, including LLM inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, agents, and guardrails.

Who You Are
  
  

* Have 6+ years of software engineering experience in a product or platform company, with hands-on ownership of production backend systems.
* Have strong low-level and high-level system design skills and can evaluate trade-offs, justify architectural decisions, and take accountability for outcomes.
* Have extensive hands-on experience with Kafka in production, including partitioning, ordering guarantees, consumer groups, rebalancing, delivery semantics, idempotency, dead-letter queues, lag monitoring, and failure recovery.
* Have experience designing and scaling high-throughput systems, with measurable examples of improvements in throughput, latency, data volume, or system capacity.
* Possess strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency and availability trade-offs, sharding, rate limiting, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
* Have a solid understanding of SQL databases, data modelling, transactions, indexing, query optimisation, caching, and queuing systems.
* Have practical experience with production ownership, on-call responsibilities, incident management, reliability targets, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Have experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools, preferably including open-source solutions such as SigNoz.
* Have demonstrated the ability to optimise database queries and infrastructure costs.
* Can communicate technical designs, document services, manage technical stakeholders, and explain complex engineering decisions clearly.
* Are proficient in Node.js or Golang and their associated frameworks, or have strong experience in one of these languages with the ability to contribute to the team’s technology stack.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems.
* Have experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical standards and engineering practices.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you will work on core commerce technology that supports a growing ecosystem of D2C brands. You will have the opportunity to solve complex backend and distributed systems challenges, shape platform architecture, improve production reliability, and influence engineering practices across teams. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership and offers the opportunity to build scalable, reliable systems that support the next phase of commerce growth.

As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally. We start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. While most companies buy technology, GTM execution and AI solutions from separate vendors, we bring them together into one connected revenue engine.

We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer who brings together deep HubSpot expertise and strong business understanding. This role is ideal for someone who can diagnose broken revenue processes, design scalable HubSpot architectures, and guide teams and clients through structured implementation.

You’ll act as a trusted advisor for clients — helping them move from messy CRM setups to clean, reliable systems that actually support sales, marketing, and service teams.

* Proactive, reliable, and ownership-driven

title: Platform Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience driving the entire sales cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, pen testing).

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
  
  
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in-depth workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Head of Quantitative Research & Algorithmic Engineering
description:
**Role Overview**

Univest is seeking a
**Head of Quantitative Research & Algorithmic Engineering**
to architect, build, and scale our next-generation automated trading and wealth management infrastructure. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of systematic strategies in Indian derivatives (NSE Equities, Index & Stock Options/Futures)—from mathematical model design and backtesting to building low-latency, production-grade Python/C++ execution engines and broker API integrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy Research & Quantitative Modeling:**

* Design, validate, and deploy high-alpha systematic strategies (options arbitrage, dynamic delta-hedging, mean-reversion, trend-following, and statistical arbitrage) for Indian F&O markets.
* Model volatility surfaces, Option Greeks, order-book dynamics, and market microstructure to build robust edge cases.
* Conduct rigorous backtesting, walk-forward validation, and stress-testing (Probability of Backtest Overfitting, Monte Carlo simulations) to eliminate curve-fitting.

**Algorithmic Execution & Infrastructure Engineering:**

* Architect and program scalable, cloud-native server-side execution systems in
  **Python and C++**
  interfacing with broker APIs, OMS/EMS, and FIX protocols.
* Optimize execution algorithms to minimize market impact, slippage, and latencies across multi-broker retail setups.
* Build automated pre-trade and post-trade risk management engines handling real-time position limits, dynamic margin utilization, and drawdown controls.

**Leadership & Scale:**

* Own the strategy deployment roadmap across retail and high-net-worth portfolio tiers.
* Oversee data pipelines (tick-level/L2/L3 order book data), infrastructure, and strategy monitoring systems.

**Requirements**

* **Quantitative Depth:**
  Proven mastery of option pricing models (Black-Scholes, IV surfaces), stochastic calculus, statistical arbitrage, and risk metrics (VaR, Sharpe/Sortino, max drawdown controls).
* **Hands-on Production Code:**
  100% mandatory expertise in Python and/or modern C++ (C++17/20) for building backend trading engines, data pipelines, and API integrations.
* **Indian Derivatives Experience:**
  Deep, hands-on experience trading or engineering strategies specifically for NSE Index & Stock Options / Futures (Nifty, BankNifty, Stock Derivatives).
* Execution & Microstructure: Practical experience with broker APIs, OMS/EMS architectures, FIX protocol, or low-latency execution routing.

title: Forward Deployed Architect, Industry Solutions
description:
**Job Description**
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Architect in our ISV Practice, you will be the technical design lead for engagements with independent software vendors (ISVs). You will work with ISV development leaders, senior engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to design how MongoDB integrates with and extends the partner’s product.
  
  
This is an application architecture role, not a database administration or database consulting role. You will ensure that the designs implemented by the team are practical, production-ready, and reusable across future partner engagements.
  
  
Learn more about here!
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  

* Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries
* Design MongoDB as a supported platform option alongside Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, including persistence abstractions, feature parity, backend-specific behavior, and certification requirements
* Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover
* Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads
* Design solutions across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or air-gapped on-premises environments
* Build reusable architecture patterns, migration playbooks, code templates, decision frameworks, and other assets that make future partner engagements faster and more consistent
* Stay hands-on by reading partner code and prototyping critical paths, act as the technical escalation point for Forward Deployed Engineers, and share recurring technical gaps and patterns with MongoDB Product and Engineering teams

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in backend engineering and application architecture, delivering production software products
* Strong application-side MongoDB expertise, including access-pattern-driven data modeling, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, replication, sharding, and sizing
* Application-level experience with at least one major relational database and integrating a new database into a large production codebase, including persistence abstraction, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, transactional boundaries, and incremental rollout
* Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB
* Strong SaaS and product-engineering knowledge, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed-cloud, Kubernetes-based private-cloud, or self-managed on-premises deployments
* The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
* Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward-deployed, resident-architect, embedded-architect, or similar technical delivery role
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka or Debezium
* Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements
* MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem
* Develop advanced experience in multi-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products
* Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

* Excellent analysis and system design capabilities, with a focus on system interactions, data flows, scalability, performance, and mapping complex business requirements into elegant, maintainable technical solutions
* Strong troubleshooting skills across diverse technologies and environments, with the ability to quickly isolate issues and drive cross-functional teams toward resolution
* Ability to mentor and upskill teammates, lead design and architecture reviews, and influence stakeholders through clear communication and well-reasoned recommendations
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and hybrid environment, and open to occasional travel as needed for key workshops or stakeholder engagements.

title: Director - T&O Data Engineering
description:
**About This Role**
The BlackRock Data Office (BDO) advances the firm's enterprise data strategy by building trusted, scalable, and governed data products that power investment, business, operational, and technology outcomes across BlackRock. As a member of the Data Office organization, you will partner closely with product managers, data stewards, platform engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and senior business stakeholders to deliver enterprise data capabilities that enable analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and digital products. The team is at the forefront of shaping BlackRock's next generation data ecosystem and driving data as a strategic asset across the firm.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
As a Director, Data Engineering, you will provide technical leadership for enterprise-scale data platforms architect who wants to do more than produce designs or provide technical advice, and drive the delivery of high-impact data solutions that support critical business and investment outcomes. You will define architectural direction for complex engineering initiatives, establish best practices across teams, serve as a trusted partner to stakeholders across technology and the business, and measurable improvements in reliability, scalability, performance, and developer productivity.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to shape long-term data strategy, mentor engineering talent, and accelerate the firm's adoption of modern data and AI-enabled capabilities
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and evolve the target-state architecture for enterprise-scale data platforms, shared services, application programming interfaces (APIs), software development kits (SDKs), metadata, configuration, and data models, while guiding investments and technology adoption that improve scalability, reliability, performance, security, interoperability, and developer experience.
* Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams from technical discovery and prototyping through implementation, rollout, and adoption, validating architectural decisions against production outcomes and adjusting designs as needed.
* Define and drive technology strategy, target-state architecture, and engineering direction across application and data platforms while ensuring alignment with broader BlackRock Data Office strategy.
* Provide technical leadership for distributed application, integration, and data platforms, guiding critical design and architecture decisions across enterprise data technologies.
* Translate business priorities into executable technology roadmaps with planned delivery objectives.
* Establish engineering standards and ensure solutions are designed for quality, resilience, security, operational excellence, and governance.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate strategic trade-offs, manage dependencies, and maximize business outcomes.
* Develop senior engineering talent and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities and intelligent automation opportunities while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

**Your Experience**

* Extensive experience in data platform architecture, data engineering, distributed systems, or related disciplines, including designing scalable, reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective enterprise data platforms across complex, multi-team environments.
* Experience designing governed data platforms for AI and structure, semi-structure and unstructured-data workloads, including object storage, document management, metadata, retrieval, vector or graph technologies, security, and operational reliability.
* Deep expertise in Python, Java, Scala, SQL, Snowflake, DBT, cloud-based data platforms, and large-scale distributed data analytics environments, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade solutions.
* Strong experience designing and operating high-volume batch and real-time data pipelines, workflow orchestration solutions, data-transformation frameworks, and distributed event streaming architectures.
* Expertise in cloud and hybrid technology environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, containerized platforms, infrastructure automation, data governance, metadata management, lineage, and enterprise security controls.
* Strong understanding of application programming interfaces, data modeling, data-quality frameworks, observability, performance optimization, and modern software-engineering practices supporting scalable platforms.
* Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and influencing organizational standards in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
* Exposure to machine learning, artificial intelligence, generative AI, and enterprise data patterns that enable AI-ready products and platforms.
* Proven architecture leadership and technical judgment across workflow orchestration, Data Operations, release management, observability, cloud infrastructure, and source-control and delivery platforms, with the ability to simplify systems and make pragmatic trade-offs.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Supply Chain Solutions Manager
description:
**About Praxas AI**

Every company runs on an ERP. Very few get good decisions out of it. That's where Praxas comes in.

Praxas AI is an AI-native supply chain platform that works as a decision layer on top of the systems a company already has. We pull in scattered data from ERPs, spreadsheets and email, turn it into a single, trusted picture, and use optimization models and AI agents to recommend what to produce, stock, buy and ship. Plans keep re-optimizing as orders, capacity and supply change, and planners stay in control by approving every action.

What we stand for is simple: no rip-and-replace, no multi-year implementations, and no multi-million-dollar planning suites. We're building planning software that's fast to deploy, easy to use and priced for mid-sized companies.

We're starting with production planning for manufacturers, because that's where our first clients feel the most pain. Inventory, sourcing and shipping come next, followed by industries such as CPG, retail, chemicals and logistics. Our first manufacturing partners are already sharing their data and building the product with us. Built in India, for the world.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with our clients and turn their messiest supply chain problems into optimized plans running in production.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a traditional consulting, project management or customer success position. You'll sit with planners and plant heads to understand how the business really runs, formulate the right mathematical model, write production-quality code, connect our platform to their ERP, and stay until the plan is trusted and used every day. You'll move between a factory floor, a solver, an ERP database and a conversation with the owner without losing the thread.

Our clients' data lives in SAP, Tally, custom ERPs, spreadsheets and inboxes, and it's rarely clean. The work is never turnkey. You'll own hard implementation problems through to resolution, and turn what you learn in the field into reusable connectors, models and playbooks that make the next deployment faster.

You'll work directly with the founders and our engineering team. As one of our first hires, you'll help define how Praxas is built, deployed and sold.

**What You Will Do**

Deliver supply chain solutions

• Embed with clients from discovery through go-live, stabilization and handover

• Map each client's production, inventory, sourcing and logistics processes, and the data behind them

• Translate business goals and ambiguous requirements into clear models, milestones and working software

• Own the outcomes clients care about: fewer lost sales, better on-time-in-full delivery, higher inventory turns and working capital released

Model and optimize

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling, inventory and safety stock, demand forecasting and supply planning problems

• Use linear and mixed-integer programming, constraint programming and heuristics, with solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX or OR-Tools

• Build models that re-optimize continuously as orders, capacity and supply change

• Validate models against real client data, test them on past periods, and explain trade-offs clearly to planners

Engineer in the client environment

• Write production-quality code in Python and SQL

• Build and maintain ERP connectors for SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics and custom databases, using APIs, OData and direct SQL

• Build data pipelines and data-quality checks, and reconcile Praxas numbers with the client's own reports

• Deploy and troubleshoot client environments on AWS, working within each client's IT and security controls

• Integrate AI agents into planning workflows, with human approval at every step

Build client capability

• Run workshops, design reviews and hands-on training for planners, purchase teams and plant heads

• Build trust in the system's recommendations so clients act on them every day

• Communicate trade-offs and risks clearly to planners, managers and owners

• Keep scope disciplined and make realistic technical commitments

Make the product better

• Turn recurring client needs into product features, reusable connectors and deployment templates

• Cut implementation time with every deployment

• Write clear documentation: data maps, model specs, runbooks and decision logs

**What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days**

• Build a working knowledge of the Praxas data model, planning engine and deployment setup

• Take one client from data access to a production plan running on their live data, with numbers that match their own reports

• Build or strengthen at least one reusable ERP connector

• Write documentation that makes the next client onboarding faster

**Within 6–12 months**

• Lead several client deployments end to end, from discovery to daily use

• Cut onboarding time from weeks to days

• Show measurable impact at your clients, such as fewer lost sales, lower inventory and better on-time delivery

• Turn field lessons into product features, connectors and playbooks the whole team uses

Who You Are

Required

• 3–8 years building or implementing supply chain planning solutions, at a platform such as o9, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis or SAP IBP, at an implementation partner, or in a similar role

• Exceptional coding ability: you write production-quality Python and SQL, and you're comfortable with APIs, data pipelines and cloud deployment

• Strong operations research and mathematical modelling: linear and mixed-integer programming, scheduling, heuristics, forecasting and inventory theory

• Hands-on experience with AI and machine learning, including building with large language models and AI agents and applying them to planning problems

• Hands-on experience integrating with ERPs such as SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle or custom systems

• Deep understanding of at least two of production planning and scheduling, demand planning, inventory planning, S&OP, procurement and logistics

• Proven client-facing skills: you can run a workshop, gather requirements and explain a model to someone who isn't technical

• Comfortable working on factory floors and travelling to client sites

Nice to have

• Experience in manufacturing, which is extremely beneficial

• A degree in operations research, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics

• Time at a startup or on an early product team

Compensation and Equity

• Competitive salary, with raises tied to company milestones

• Meaningful equity through ESOPs, vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, so you own part of what you help build

• Early-team ownership: a real say in the product, the way we deploy it and the culture we build

**How to Apply**

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile to admin@praxas.ai with the subject line "Forward Deployed Engineer – Supply Chain". Include a short note on a model or integration you built, and what changed for the client because of it.

title: Co-Founder & CTO
description:
**I'm not looking for someone to build an app. I'm looking for someone to build a company with me.**

I've spent years building Snapzo, made mistakes, learnt from them and understood what it really takes to build a scalable technology business.

Now I'm looking for a technical co-founder who can take complete ownership of technology while I focus on business, growth, partnerships and fundraising.

**What you'll be building:**

* Own Snapzo's technology vision, architecture and product development.
* Lead the development of our mobile applications and backend infrastructure.
* Work with our existing native mobile stack, PHP and Python backend, and make the right technology decisions for the future.
* Build a scalable, secure and reliable platform capable of supporting millions of users.
* Hire, mentor and lead the engineering team as we grow.
* Work directly with me on product strategy, user experience, monetisation and investor discussions.
* Move fast, test assumptions and build around product-market fit rather than unnecessary features.

**Who I'm looking for:**

* 7–12+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering and product development.
* Strong understanding of mobile applications, backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
* Someone who has built and shipped real products, not just managed developers.
* Comfortable working with an existing codebase and improving it without rebuilding everything.
* A problem solver who understands business as much as technology.
* Someone who can work with limited resources today while preparing for much bigger opportunities tomorrow.
* Most importantly, someone who thinks like an owner, not an employee.

**One thing you should know.**

Snapzo is at an early stage. This isn't a conventional CTO position with a large team, established processes and guaranteed comfort.

There will be unpredictable days, difficult decisions and moments when we'll have to figure things out ourselves.

I'm looking for someone who can see what Snapzo could become over the next 5–10 years and is willing to put in the work to get there.

**This is a co-founder opportunity with an equity-led structure, subject to mutual agreement.**
We'll discuss ownership, commitment and long-term alignment transparently.

I don't expect you to know everything.

But I do expect you to take responsibility for finding the answers.

**I've already taken my bet on Snapzo. Now I'm looking for someone who wants to build it alongside me.**

If that sounds like you, don't send me just your CV. Tell me what you've built and why you want to build Snapzo.

Bachelor's Degree

title: Product Engineer (App and Platforms)
description: Job DescriptionThis is a delivery-focused role rather than a purely supervisory one: you will carry out the majority of the day-to-day design, development, and implementation work directly. You will be Ansh's primary technical owner of our app and website, working closely with our Analytics Engineer to ensure data flows cleanly from the app into our dashboards, with the M& E and program teams to understand their requirements, and with the C-suite to ensure our technology and roadmap keep pace with our growth. Our tech team is small, so this role calls for a startup mentality and the initiative to step outside a predefined job description when something needs doing, rather than waiting to be asked. The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Develop and improve our field app: - Design and implement new features within our FlutterFlow app, from requirements gathering through to build and delivery, translating input from the M& E and operations teams into working functionality. - Maintain the app's underlying databases, including making manual data updates where required. - Own the full bug and issue-tracking cycle, identifying, prioritising, assigning, and resolving issues that affect app stability, data collection, or care delivery. - Manage version control and releases, testing and publishing new app versions, writing release notes, and notifying the team of changes. - Manage app accounts and access for team members, providing technical support where needed. - Periodically review and improve the app's design, evaluating user interface and user experience to improve usability. Maintain our website, tech systems and accounts: - Maintain and update Ansh's website (built in Wix), including content changes, functionality fixes, and periodic design/UX review. - Manage and maintain integrations with third-party tools (e. g., Trello, Slack, Google Workspace tools, Firebase), keeping systems efficient, up-to-date, and aligned with organisational needs. - Manage accounts and access for the tools and platforms our team relies on day-to-day (e. g. app accounts, website admin access, and other core tools), including onboarding and offboarding team members from a technical standpoint. - Conduct orientation on technology and tools for new team members. - Maintain basic security hygiene across the systems you own: access permissions, password practices, and account recovery. - Ensure backups for FlutterFlow, GitHub, and Firestore are conducted and monitored. - Support with ad-hoc technology projects and transitions, e. g. changing our Google Workspace. - Support with increased AI integration and technology innovation across the organisation. Follow good technical practice: - Apply sound engineering practices to keep our dashboards and app reliable and maintainable as they scale, rather than optimising only for short-term delivery. - Document your work clearly, so that systems and decisions are understood across the organisation rather than held only by you. - Recommend new tools or approaches that would help Ansh's team deliver more effectively. Work closely with the C-suite and program team: - Support the C-suite in building the product roadmap for our app and website, bringing a technical perspective on feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. - Bring a technical perspective into strategic planning conversations, so Ansh's data and tooling keep pace with its growth ambitions. - Partner with M& E and program leads to prioritise what gets built next, based on what will most improve data quality, decision-making, or field operations. Requirements: - Around 3+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on work developing mobile or low-code app platforms (FlutterFlow, Flutter, or comparable front-end platforms). - Comfortable using AI-assisted coding tools (e. g. Claude Code) as part of a modern development workflow, with the discipline to keep the resulting code maintainable rather than simply expedient. - Comfortable managing accounts, access, and basic security practices across a small set of tools and platforms. - Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements from non-technical colleagues into technical specifications, and to explain technical trade-offs back to them clearly. - High ownership and agency: comfortable being the primary technical owner of these systems in a rapidly growing organisation, and able to resolve blockers independently. - Adaptability: comfortable supporting new technology projects as they arise. - Fluent in English; based in India and comfortable working remotely with a distributed, mission-driven team. - Deep alignment with Ansh's mission, and a serious, evidence-based commitment to impact. Strongly preferred/nice to have: - Direct experience with FlutterFlow specifically. - Experience with website builders such as Wix, Webflow, or similar. - Experience integrating data from custom-built mobile or field applications into analytics tools. - Experience contributing to product prioritisation or roadmap discussions. - Familiarity with data privacy and security considerations for health data. - Fluency in Hindi. Company Summary Globally, 2.4 million children died in the first month of life in 2020 India alone accounted for 22% of these newborn deaths. The leading risk factor for mortality among children under five years of age is low birth weight, which is responsible for more than 80% of neonatal deaths. A simple solution holds the potential to significantly reduce these deaths: placing low birth weight infants directly onto the mother's chest for skin-to-skin contact, an intervention known as Kangaroo Care (KC). KC entails not only prolonged and continuous skin-to-skin contact but also exclusive breastfeeding and close monitoring of the infant. KC has proven to effectively reduce mortality and morbidity rates by around 33% (compared to the standard of care using electric incubators) by preventing hypothermia, fighting infections like sepsis, and helping the newborn gain weight through the caregiver's heat. However, adoption barriers for kangaroo care in LMICs, such as India, persist. These include insufficient equipment, a shortage of human resources, and a lack of privacy within healthcare facilities. Many of our target healthcare facilities even lack the infrastructure for conventional standard of care (i. e., electric incubators), further amplifying the potential impact of Kangaroo Care in low-resource settings. Our approach is both direct and cost-effective: repurpose existing hospital spaces to facilitate KC, provide essential equipment like infant weighing scales and cloth binders, and expand capacity by training and hiring health workers (HW) dedicated to teaching and monitoring KC for mothers in the wards. Why Join Us Ansh is committed to equal opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and strongly encourage applications from people who are underrepresented in this sector. We do not discriminate based on gender, age, disability, caste, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race. We are looking for someone genuinely interested in people and equally comfortable with the process. You will need to hold confidence, tell leadership things they may not want to hear, and keep the administrative backbone of the function running!Required Skills['Flutter', 'FlutterFlow']Additional InformationSource recruiter: Poppy Hosford Source recruiter designation: Chief of Staff Company tagline: Providing kangaroo care Employee count: 10 Company founded: 2023 Benefits: Competitive nonprofit compensation, Health insurance, Flexibility in how you work, Premium health insurance, Growth opportunity, Continuous improvement and collaboration Company tech stack: BigQuery, Flutter, Python, SQL, Machine Learning Website: https://www.ansh.health/ LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ansh-health/about/ Instahyre score: NA Strong match: NA Accept outstation: true Company tagline: Providing kangaroo care Logo: https://media.instahyre.com/images/profile/base/employer/56044/e3e6b4d1be/ansh_health_logo.webp

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
  
  
With 2.4M+ daters, 1.47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world.
  
  
Link to our fundraising announcement
  
  
**Key Offerings Of Hunch**

* One Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.

**About The Role**
We're on the lookout for a SDE-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We’re looking for immediate joiners. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own backend features end-to-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async & event-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node + Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice-to-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design & delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End-to-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.

**Preferred Experience**

* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.
* LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.
* Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.
* Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive pay along with an annual performance-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).

**Life at Hunch**
Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room.
  
  
**What We Hire For - The ABCs**
Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
  
  

* Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.

**How We Work**

* Ownership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real - We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week - show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out - Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems - You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.

**Backed by Global Investors**
Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
  
  
**Experienced Leadership**
Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) - serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer-tech startup.

and accessibility.

mechanisms.

production environments.

• Establish software engineering standards, conduct code reviews, implement automated testing, and ensure

application and infrastructure security.

• Independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues involving application performance, databases,

management and stakeholders to deliver business requirements.

including Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SQL.

FastAPI, Node.js, or equivalent platforms.

• Experience designing and developing web and mobile applications along with a strong understanding of UI/UX

principles and design tools.

• Expert-level knowledge of both AWS and Microsoft Azure, including cloud networking, compute, storage, identity

• Advanced experience with Linux server administration, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub

Actions, Azure DevOps, and automated deployment workflows.

experience in database design, query optimization, replication, and data processing.

• Extensive understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, message

• Proven experience designing scalable, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure software solutions, including load

balancing, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.

• Strong experience with production monitoring, centralized logging, observability, incident management, and

**Position Title: Enterprise Architect**

Job Description Summary: We are seeking a seasoned Enterprise Architect to own the alignment between business strategy and enterprise technology direction. The ideal candidate brings deep experience translating executive priorities into a defensible, multi-year technology roadmap; running formal architecture governance (Engineering Design Authority, Architecture Review Board); leading legacy-to-cloud modernization across multiple systems and teams; and identifying overlapping tools and technical debt that inflate cost of ownership. This role sits above individual product or platform architecture — it requires enterprise-wide ownership of governance, risk, and technology investment, with credibility to operate directly with business leadership and the CXO/board.

**Location: NCR / Bangalore / Pune**

**Experience: 15 - 18 Years+**

**Job Description and Responsibilities**

• Own alignment between enterprise IT strategy and overall business strategy, translating multi-year executive priorities into a defensible technology investment roadmap.

• Define and maintain the enterprise architecture blueprint — business, application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers — ensuring design coherence across the full platform and product portfolio.

• Establish and enforce enterprise technology governance: standards for tool selection, build-vs-buy decisions, coding practices, reference architectures, and architectural compliance across engineering teams.

• Own enterprise risk management for the technology estate — identify architectural, security, and operational weak spots in current systems and drive remediation plans through to closure.

• Act as the primary technical translator between business leadership and engineering, presenting architecture options, trade-offs, risks, and roadmaps in business terms to executive stakeholders.

• Partner with business and product leaders to convert business requirements into target-state technical solutions, with clear traceability from business capability to system design.

• Chair the Engineering Design Authority (EDA) reviewing and approving (or rejecting) new project designs against enterprise standards prior to funding and build sign-off.

• Drive technology and tool rationalization across business units — identify overlapping or redundant platforms and build the business case for consolidation to lower total cost of ownership.

• Define enterprise-wide non-functional standards covering performance, scalability, resilience, security, and regulatory/data-privacy compliance.

• Build and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and reusable frameworks that delivery teams across the organization can adopt directly.

• Own the technology vendor and product evaluation process, ensuring new tools and platforms meet enterprise architecture, security, and integration standards before onboarding.

• Mentor senior architects and technical leads, building architecture maturity, bench-strength, and succession depth across the organization.

• Track and report architecture governance compliance, approved exceptions, and technical debt exposure to executive leadership on a regular cadence.

**Essential Qualifications and Skills**

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• 15–18 years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or enterprise architecture, including at least 5 years operating at an enterprise-wide (not single-product) architecture level.

• Proven experience running formal architecture governance bodies (ARB, EDA, or equivalent) with real decision-making authority over project approvals and exceptions.

• Strong practical grounding in enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or Zachman, applied to real governance and roadmap decisions, not just certification knowledge.

• Track record of building and defending a multi-year technology roadmap directly to CXO or board-level stakeholders.

• Experience driving technology portfolio rationalization and cost optimization with quantified, defensible outcomes.

• Working knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), modern data architecture, integration patterns, and security/compliance frameworks.

• Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to operate independently with business unit heads, CXOs, and regulators.

• TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification strongly preferred.

**Desirable Qualifications and Skills**

• Experience in insurance, insurtech, BFSI, or other regulated, transaction-heavy domains.

• Exposure to policy administration, billing, claims, or reporting platforms within the insurance value chain.

• Experience architecting for regulatory and compliance regimes (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, insurance-specific regulatory frameworks).

• Experience building or scaling an enterprise architecture governance function from the ground up.

• Prior ownership of a technology budget or P&L, with direct accountability for cost outcomes.

• Leadership experience across globally distributed or virtual teams.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

• A published, executive-approved multi-year enterprise technology roadmap with a clear line of sight to business strategy.

• EDA and ARB operate as genuine decision gates — projects are approved or rejected against defined criteria, not rubber-stamped.

• A measurable reduction in overlapping tools and licenses, with quantified total-cost-of-ownership savings.

• Legacy systems migrated to modern cloud architecture against a documented, risk-managed plan with minimal business disruption.

• Business and technology leadership rely on the enterprise architecture function as the trusted authority for major technology decisions.
