title: Technical Architect
description:
**About dunnhumby**
dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.
  
  
**Tesco Media**
Tesco Media is the ultimate media partner to brands. Built on unrivalled customer insight, it’s a media owner with soul, scale, and storytelling power. Tesco Media helps brands and agencies connect meaningfully with customers, drive creative effectiveness, and grow at the point of purchase.
  
  
**About the Role**
We are looking for an Technical Architect to join our engineering organization and help shape the future of our SaaS platform. Our platform powers retail media solutions for global retailers and CPGs, enabling end-to-end advertisement campaigns across e-commerce sites, in-store channels, and social media platforms.
  
  
This role is pivotal in defining architectural guardrails, frameworks, and patterns that enable multiple squads to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure solutions. You will combine hands-on technical depth with the ability to influence and align engineering managers, lead engineers, and product leaders. This is not an ivory-tower role — you will actively partner with teams, ensuring architecture decisions are practical, business-aligned, and execution ready.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Architectural Leadership: Define and evolve application architecture in line with business and product strategy for a global retail media SaaS platform.
* Set Guardrails: Establish repeatable patterns for microservices, APIs, identity/auth, observability, and data flows.
* NFR Ownership: Ensure non-functional requirements (scalability, reliability, resiliency, observability, security, maintainability) are embedded into design decision.
* Cross-Squad Influence: Collaborate with multiple squads (frontend, backend, BFF, platform services) to align on architectural choices.
* Tech Evaluations: Lead structured assessments of new tools and frameworks (e.g., OPA, SpiceDB, caching, API gateways) and guide adoption.
* Decision Frameworks: Move teams away from ad-hoc debates by creating clear frameworks for architectural decision-making.
* Mentorship: Partner with engineering managers and lead engineers to strengthen design-level thinking and technical maturity.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong hands-on expertise across modern application architecture

+ .NET Core, C#, REST APIs, microservices.
+ Event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka, or similar).
+ Databases (Postgres, SQL Server, caching strategies with Redis or Couchbase).

* Identity & authorization frameworks (Auth0, OPA, SpiceDB, OpenFGA).
* Observability platforms (New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Cloud-native experience (GCP preferred; AWS/Azure acceptable).
* An understanding of AI-enabled application patterns and workflow orchestration frameworks.
* Awareness of emerging AI and agentic workflow technologies and their application across retail media, advertising, analytics, and SaaS platforms, with the ability to assess their architectural implications and business value
* Strong track record of embedding NFRs into platform and product design.
* Excellent communicators can simplify trade-offs for both engineers and business stakeholders.
* Experience influencing without authority and driving closure across multiple teams.

**You'll Thrive If You**
...
  
  

* Enjoy solving complex technical and organisational challenges.
* Can balance long-term architectural vision with practical delivery needs.
* Build strong partnerships across engineering, product, and business teams.
* Take ownership and drive continual improvement in technology standards and practices.

**India Benefits**

* Comprehensive medical insurance of INR 500,000 covering employees and eligible dependents, with dental and vision benefits included.
* Group Term Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident cover, with coverage levels linked to employee grade.
* Retirement benefits including Provident Fund, Gratuity, and voluntary National Pension Scheme (NPS).
* Employee Assistance Programme, Indian Health Organisation (IHO) membership, and wellbeing resources through the Wellness Hub.
* Internet allowance, office commute support, work-from-home kit, subsidised meals, and Early Friday each month.
* 25 days annual leave plus 10 public holidays, birthday leave, maternity, paternity and adoption leave provisions.

**Our approach to Flexible Working**
At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work. We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process. For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found(here)

.

**Node.js, React.js, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda, Amazon Bedrock, microservices, distributed systems, OCR, RAG, and practical AI/LLM implementation**

  .

  **Amazon Bedrock**
  .

  **AI/LLM workflows, OCR pipelines, Vision AI, structured data extraction, and RAG systems**
  .

  .

  .

Strong hands-on experience with
**React.js, Node.js, Express.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and REST APIs**
.

Strong understanding of:

* **HLD, LLD, scalable architecture, and microservices**

* Database design, query optimization, and API architecture
* Concurrency, caching, load balancing, and horizontal scaling

* Performance optimization and architectural trade-offs

**converting business requirements into detailed, scalable technical designs and implementing them independently**
.

Strong practical knowledge of
**microservices, distributed processing, asynchronous workflows, and event-driven system architecture**
.

Hands-on expertise with:

* **AWS Lambda:**
  Serverless development, deployment, concurrency, performance optimization, and scaling.
* **Amazon Bedrock:**
  Foundation model integration and production AI workflows.

  **AWS S3, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM**

**Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar messaging and caching technologies**
.

Understanding of
**worker concurrency, queue-based processing, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, failure recovery, observability, and cloud cost optimization**
.

Deep expertise across every AWS service is not required.

Hands-on experience implementing production AI applications involving:

* LLM integration, prompt engineering, and context management.
* **OCR, Vision AI, multimodal models, and PDF/image processing**

* Document classification, table/form extraction, and structured JSON outputs.
* Schema validation, error handling, and hallucination reduction.
* Multi-stage AI processing pipelines and model orchestration.
* Token optimization, AI latency management, and cost reduction.
* AI evaluation, accuracy improvement, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

The candidate should understand how to build
**reliable AI features beyond simply making LLM API calls**
.

4. RAG & AI Workflow Architecture

Hands-on experience designing and implementing
**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
systems, including:

* Document ingestion, chunking, and embeddings
* Vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, and metadata filtering
* Retrieval optimization, reranking, and context construction
* Response grounding and RAG evaluation

Working knowledge of
**AI agents, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, state management, and contextual memory**
.

Experience with
**LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks**
is preferred.

5. Scalability, Performance & Engineering Ownership

The candidate should be capable of:

* Designing architectures for high-volume document and AI processing.
* Performing capacity planning, throughput estimation, and load testing.
* Building scalable background workers and asynchronous pipelines.
* Optimizing APIs, databases, model calls, and infrastructure.
* Troubleshooting complex production issues.
* Making architectural decisions and explaining technical trade-offs.
* Independently owning complex technical modules from requirements to deployment.

Good to Have

* Experience with
  **US Healthcare, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical coding, insurance claims, or HIPAA-aware applications**
  .
* Advanced AI agents, multi-agent workflows, and agent orchestration.
* Knowledge graphs, graph-based retrieval, and advanced AI memory.
* Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks and feedback-driven improvement systems.

Experience Required

* **3–5 years of professional software development experience**
  .
* Strong full-stack development experience, particularly in backend engineering.
* Strong system design, microservices, and scalable architecture knowledge.
* Hands-on experience with
  **AWS Lambda and Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **AI/LLM integration, OCR, and RAG**
  .
* Ability to independently design, implement, and own complex technical modules.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a
**hands-on engineer and strong system thinker**
who can take ownership of architecture, development, AI integration, scalability, and production reliability.

The ideal candidate should be able to design distributed architectures, implement production-ready modules, optimize high-volume AI processing workflows, and solve complex engineering challenges independently.

* **Our highest priorities are system design, scalable backend architecture, microservices, AWS Lambda, and practical AI implementation.**

title: Application Engineering, Principal Engineer
description:
We Are
  
  
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You are a DDR/LPDDR Controller System Architecture Specialist who can work directly with customer architects to close real system-level memory subsystem design decisions.
  
  
You are comfortable discussing SoC integration, memory subsystem architecture, controller configuration, performance optimization, power management, validation, and interoperability topics. You can help customers evaluate technical trade-offs and guide them toward practical architecture decisions.
  
  
This is a customer-facing technical role. You will help customers integrate DDR/LPDDR controller IP into complex SoCs, identify key requirements or gaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable input for Synopsys Product Management, R&D, and roadmap planning.
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

* Own the technical architecture engagement for DDR/LPDDR controller IP with strategic customers, from early platform requirements through architecture closure and initial deployment readiness.
* Work with customer architects and engineering teams to define suitable DDR/LPDDR memory subsystem configurations for advanced SoC platforms.
* Analyze system-level trade-offs related to memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and scalability.
* Translate customer platform requirements and integration constraints into clear feedback for Synopsys Product Management, R&D, and roadmap planning.
* Support technical closure of design wins by providing architecture guidance, configuration recommendations and competitive positioning.
* Develop reusable technical material, application notes, and customer-facing guidance based on real engagement experience.
* Train FAEs and customer teams on DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem integration, performance tuning, validation expectations, and deployment best practices.

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Improve the quality of DDR/LPDDR design wins by ensuring customer memory architectures are technically sound before commitment.
* Strengthen Synopsys DDR/LPDDR roadmap by feeding real customer memory subsystem requirements into product planning and R&D execution.
* Reduce customer integration risk by identifying architecture, performance, power, validation, and bring-up issues early.
* Help establish Synopsys as a trusted technical partner for next-generation AI, HPC, mobile, automotive, networking, and edge computing platforms.

What You’ll Need
  
  

* Bachelors and/or Masters Degree in Electrical and/or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science
* 5+ years of experience in DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem design, SoC integration, silicon validation, systems engineering, applications engineering, or customer-facing technical leadership.
* Solid understanding of DDR and/or LPDDR controller IP, including memory architecture concepts, controller configuration, scheduling, quality of service, power management, training, validation, or system integration.
* Good system-level understanding of SoC integration and ability to reason through memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and software/firmware trade-offs.
* Experience engaging directly with customer architects, design teams, validation teams, and technical decision-makers.
* Ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical recommendations, product feedback, and closure plans.
* Strong technical communication skills, including clear written analysis, structured trade-off explanation, and ability to align customer, sales, product, and engineering teams.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Linux, firmware bring-up, or software-driven debug of DDR/LPDDR subsystems.
* Familiarity with advanced SoC architectures used in AI, HPC, automotive, mobile, networking, or compute platforms.
* Experience with memory performance analysis, traffic modeling, quality-of-service management, memory hierarchy optimization, or system-level benchmarking.
* Knowledge of advanced topics such as DDR5, LPDDR5X, LPDDR6, memory training algorithms, RAS features, chiplet-based memory architectures, or AI memory bandwidth optimization.

The Team You’ll be a Part Of
  
  
You will be part of our IP high-performance computing applications engineering team, a group of dedicated professionals who are passionate about technology and innovation. The team focuses on helping customers integrate more capabilities into SoCs faster, working collaboratively across geographic and organizational boundaries to drive revenue growth and accelerate business closure.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
  
  
Inclusion and Diversity
  
  
Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Migration Architect to lead complex Data Centre Exit and DC Consolidation programmes, migrating large-scale enterprise estates to Amazon Web Services (AWS). This is a technically demanding, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of cloud architecture, migration engineering, and programme delivery.
  
  
You will be responsible for the end-to-end architectural direction of migration programmes — from initial discovery and dependency mapping through to wave execution, cutover, and post-migration optimisation. You will bring deep expertise in AWS infrastructure, licensing portability (BYOL, BYOS, AWS Licence Manager), network transformation using AWS Transit Gateway and Direct Connect, and the unique complexities that arise when exiting or consolidating physical data centres onto AWS.
  
  
This role is suited to an architect who is equally comfortable whiteboarding a target-state AWS Landing Zone architecture with a CTO and sitting with an engineering team to resolve a blast-radius dependency conflict the night before a cutover.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Design and own the target-state cloud architecture for DC Exit / DC Consolidation programmes on AWS, including compute (EC2, ECS, EKS), storage (EBS, EFS, S3), networking (VPC, Transit Gateway), identity (IAM, AWS SSO), and security (AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, SCPs)
* Lead application and infrastructure discovery using AWS Application Discovery Service (ADS), Migration Evaluator, and dependency mapping to produce migration-ready groupings and blast radius analysis
* Define migration patterns (rehost via AWS MGN, replatform to RDS/EKS, refactor to Lambda/containers, retire, replace with SaaS) per workload with clear technical rationale and risk assessment
* Produce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), High-Level Designs (HLDs), and Low-Level Designs (LLDs) to programme-grade quality, aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework
* Govern architectural consistency across migration waves and enforce AWS Landing Zone / Control Tower guardrails throughout the transition

**Licensing Portability & Compliance**

* Lead licensing portability strategy for DC exit — BYOL (Bring Your Own Licence) for Windows Server and SQL Server on EC2, AWS Licence Manager configuration, OEM licence impact analysis, and SPLA transition planning for MSP-operated environments moving to AWS
* Advise on AWS Dedicated Hosts as the mechanism for BYOL compliance for Windows Server and SQL Server (per-socket/per-core licence models), ensuring licence counts are correctly mapped to Dedicated Host instance families
* Design licence governance controls using AWS Licence Manager rules, resource tagging strategies via AWS Config, and integration with third-party SAM tooling (Flexera, Snow Software) to prevent compliance drift post-migration
* Engage the AWS account team and AWS Partner Network (APN) to maximise programme value through AWS Migration Acceleration Programme (MAP) funding, AWS Credits, and AWS Professional Services co-delivery

**Network Transformation**

* Design target-state hybrid network architectures on AWS: AWS Transit Gateway (TGW) as the centralised routing hub, AWS Direct Connect (dedicated and hosted connections), Site-to-Site VPN as failover, and SD-WAN integration with TGW Connect
* Define internet egress and traffic inspection strategy for the post-DC state, replacing DC-based security perimeters with AWS Network Firewall, AWS Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) with third-party NVAs (Palo Alto, Fortinet), and AWS WAF
* Lead DNS transformation planning — Amazon Route 53 Private Hosted Zones, Route 53 Resolver (inbound/outbound endpoints), split-horizon DNS — and IP addressing strategy for migration with minimal re-IP using AWS IPAM
* Design VPC architecture across accounts and regions: hub-and-spoke or flat TGW models, VPC sharing via AWS RAM, and PrivateLink for service consumption without public exposure
* Ensure latency-sensitive workloads (ERP, payments, OT/SCADA) are isolated in dedicated VPCs with appropriate Direct Connect SIFs and QoS, and their connectivity requirements validated pre-cutover

**Migration Programme Delivery**

* Own the migration wave plan using AWS Migration Hub as the central tracking plane — sequencing, dependency groupings, rollback criteria, and cutover playbooks across programmes of 500+ workloads
* Lead rehost migrations using AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) for agent-based lift-and-shift, and AWS Server Migration Service (SMS) or AWS VMware Cloud on AWS (VMC) for VMware estate migration
* Define and enforce go/no-go criteria for each migration wave, including pre-flight AWS MGN replication lag thresholds, post-cutover smoke test suites, and DNS TTL management during cutover windows
* Manage and resolve technical blockers across infrastructure, networking, security, and application teams during wave execution
* Ensure regulated workloads (financial services, public sector) are handled with appropriate regulatory notifications, BCP/DR evidence updated in AWS Resilience Hub, and audit trails via AWS CloudTrail

**FinOps & Cost Governance**

* Build pre-migration cost models using AWS Migration Evaluator and AWS Pricing Calculator, incorporating BYOL savings on Dedicated Hosts, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance pricing, S3 storage tiering, and data transfer / egress cost assumptions
* Establish a FinOps operating model — visibility via AWS Cost Explorer and Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), accountability through AWS account-level tagging and chargeback, optimisation via Compute Optimizer and Savings Plans, governance via AWS Budgets and anomaly detection
* Conduct post-migration right-sizing reviews using AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations and Trusted Advisor checks to close the gap between business case projections and actual AWS spend

**Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Act as the primary technical authority for client stakeholders up to CTO / CIO level, translating complex AWS architectural decisions into clear business outcomes
* Lead multi-vendor technical governance — defining interface agreements, RACI frameworks, and joint testing protocols across SIs, MSPs, and AWS
* Manage AWS account team, network vendors (Direct Connect providers, SD-WAN), and third-party migration tooling vendors as an integrated programme team

**Essential**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, with a significant portion focused on large-scale migration programmes (DC Exit, DC consolidation, or cloud-first transformation) on AWS
* Deep hands-on expertise in AWS compute and migration services: EC2 (including Dedicated Hosts for BYOL), AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), AWS Migration Hub, AWS Application Discovery Service (ADS), and AWS Database Migration Service (DMS)
* Demonstrable expertise in AWS licensing portability: BYOL on Dedicated Hosts (Windows Server and SQL Server per-socket/per-core models), AWS Licence Manager configuration, OEM licence restrictions, and SPLA transition planning for MSP colo environments
* Network transformation experience: AWS Transit Gateway, Direct Connect (dedicated and hosted), VPC design (hub-and-spoke, shared VPCs), Route 53 Resolver, AWS Network Firewall, and SD-WAN integration with TGW Connect
* Proven experience designing and executing migration wave plans for estates of 500+ VMs in enterprise or regulated environments, using AWS Migration Hub as the tracking plane
* AWS Landing Zone / Control Tower design and guardrail enforcement across multi-account organisations
* FinOps experience: AWS Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), Compute Optimizer, Savings Plans, and pre-migration cost modelling using AWS Migration Evaluator

title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**Software Development Engineer – I (SDE-1)**

For Engineers Who Love Solving Hard Problems, Building Fast, and Owning Outcomes

**Experience:**
0–1 years

**Eligibility:**
Tier-1 colleges only

**Work experience preference:**
Engineers with experience at reputed product-based technology companies

**Role type:**
Individual Contributor

**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s most trusted Muslim Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. With
**65,000+ success storie**
s and
**over 2 Million+ members**
, we are committed to fostering strong connections and building a better community. Our AI-based algorithm ensures seamless profile searches and connections, transforming the way people approach marriage. Based in India, NikahForever has created a user-friendly platform where finding your life partner happens in just three steps: Register, Search, and Connect.

**About the Role**

We are looking for exceptional engineers who don't get intimidated by unfamiliar technologies, ambiguous problems, or tight deadlines.

We don't expect you to be an expert in every tech stack. We expect you to be the kind of engineer who can pick up a new stack, understand an unfamiliar codebase, break down a complex problem, and figure out a way to solve it.

You could be working on backend systems today, debugging a production issue tomorrow, building an AI-powered workflow the next day, or exploring a completely new technology to solve a business problem.

**We care more about how you think, how fast you learn, and what you can build than the number of technologies listed on your resume.**

This role is for people who want to become exceptionally good engineers by working on real problems, taking ownership, and shipping things that matter.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own problems end to end:**
  Take a problem from understanding requirements to designing, building, testing, deploying, and monitoring the solution.
* **Work across tech stacks:**
  Be comfortable moving between frontend, backend, databases, infrastructure, APIs, and AI tooling as the problem requires.
* **Build with AI at the core:**
  Use AI coding assistants, agentic coding workflows, and autonomous AI agents to accelerate development, debugging, testing, and problem-solving.
* **Think beyond the obvious:**
  Challenge assumptions, identify root causes, and find simple, scalable solutions instead of blindly following instructions.
* **Move fast and ship:**
  Turn ideas into working software quickly without compromising on correctness, reliability, or maintainability.
* **Take production ownership:**
  Investigate bugs, performance bottlenecks, unexpected failures, and real-world edge cases.
* **Explore and experiment:**
  Evaluate new frameworks, tools, models, and technologies based on whether they solve the problem better.
* **Operate with high ownership:**
  If something needs to be done, figure out how to get it done instead of waiting for someone to spell out every step.

**What We're Looking For**

* **B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program.**
* 0–1 years of professional software engineering experience.
* Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, databases, networking, and software engineering.
* The ability to learn unfamiliar technologies independently and become productive quickly.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. You should be able to reason through a problem rather than depend entirely on tutorials or existing solutions.
* A builder's mindset: you've built projects, experimented with technology, automated something, or gone beyond the standard academic curriculum.
* Genuine interest in AI-assisted software engineering and
  **agentic AI**
  — not just using AI to generate snippets, but exploring agents, tool calling, MCP, multi-step workflows, and autonomous task execution.
* Comfort working in an environment with high expectations, rapid execution, changing priorities, and significant individual responsibility.
* Clear communication, intellectual honesty, and the ability to ask the right questions when stuck.

**Prior experience at a reputed product-based technology company is a strong plus.**
We particularly value candidates who have already worked on real production systems, shipped features to actual users, or dealt with the complexities of maintaining software beyond a college project.

The Kind of Engineer Who Will Thrive Here

**You will probably enjoy this role if:**

* You see a new technology as something to figure out, not a reason to say a task is outside your expertise.
* You use AI to multiply your output, but understand the code you ship and take responsibility for its correctness.
* You would rather build a working prototype today and improve it through feedback than spend a week debating an implementation.
* You naturally investigate how things work under the hood.
* You take pride in solving a problem even when the solution isn't obvious.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity and don't need every task broken into tiny, predefined steps.
* You want to build things that real users depend on and see the measurable impact of your work.
* You are ambitious about your growth and willing to put in the extra effort when an important problem demands it.

**What This Role Is NOT**

* A role where you work exclusively within one programming language or framework.
* A role where your job ends at writing code and handing it off.
* A role where you wait for detailed instructions before taking the next step.
* A role where AI is treated as a novelty rather than a serious engineering productivity tool.
* A role suited to someone who prefers predictable tasks, narrowly defined responsibilities, and minimal technical exploration.

**How We Evaluate Candidates**

We care about engineering ability, learning speed, judgment, and execution.

Our evaluation may include:

* Data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving.
* Practical coding and debugging.
* Reasoning through unfamiliar systems or technologies.
* Building a small working solution with appropriate AI tools.
* Understanding how to verify AI-generated code, identify failure modes, and make sound engineering trade-offs.
* Ownership, communication, and the ability to explain technical decisions.

**Why Join?**

* Solve real engineering problems with meaningful product impact.
* Work across technologies rather than being boxed into a single stack.
* Build practical experience with AI-native and agentic engineering workflows.
* Take ownership early and learn by shipping.
* Work in an environment that values initiative, engineering judgment, and measurable outcomes.

**If you enjoy solving problems more than discussing why they are difficult, use AI to build faster, and want to become an engineer who can figure almost anything out — we'd like to hear from you.**

**Apply Now!**

title: CTC Functional Solution Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Purpose of the Role:**
**The Solution Architect — Functional, Credit to Cash is the functional design authority for the end-to-end Credit to Cash value chain.**
The outcome is a Credit to Cash process that is predictable, automated and controlled: faster and better credit decisions, higher straight-through cash application, risk-based and largely automated collections, fewer exceptions and disputes, lower DSO and overdue, and <1 Day Resolution wherever the process allows. Everything this role does serves that outcome.
  
  
The scope is the Credit to Cash value chain end to end, not a single module or platform — customer onboarding and credit risk assessment, credit limits, scoring, reviews and order hold or release; billing and invoice presentment as they feed receivables; customer statements and self-service portals; collections strategy, worklists and dunning; payment capture, bank statement and lockbox processing, remittance capture and cash application; unapplied and on-account cash; deductions, short-pays, claims and disputes; AR accounting, reconciliation, write-offs and bad-debt provisioning; and the period-end close, controls, reporting and KPIs that sit on top. The role designs across this scope as one integrated solution rather than as separate credit, collections and cash solutions.
  
  
A central part of the remit is bringing HighRadius into Diageo. The postholder leads the functional architecture and design for the HighRadius Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management modules — and the adjacent capabilities that touch them, such as deductions and integrates them with S/4HANA / ECC FI-AR and FSCM, banks, ClaimOne (under Control Tower) and the wider Customer Operations landscape. HighRadius is an enabler of the target design, not the design itself; the role decides what the process should be first, and then how the platform best delivers it.
  
  
The role combines four capabilities in one person. As a functional solution architect, they own the end-to-end Credit to Cash solution blueprint, the fit-gap against the global standard and the design decisions that hold it together. As a platform expert, they turn the blueprint into working configuration and integration design on HighRadius and SAP FSCM — matching rules, AI models, collection strategies, credit scoring and workflows. As a consultant, they diagnose where cash, credit and collection issues are really created and build the case for the fix. As a design authority, they set standards, review and assure the work of Specialists, system integrators and vendors, and keep the solution coherent as it scales across markets.
  
  
**The defining discipline of this role is architecting the value chain, not the module.**
A well-configured cash application engine is a smaller prize than a remittance that arrives clean; a sophisticated collections strategy is a smaller prize than a credit decision and invoice that never become overdue. The postholder is expected to design the hand-offs — order and credit, invoice and remittance, payment and dispute, AR and the ledger — as carefully as the modules themselves, and to push the fix upstream into O2I, Commercial, master data or the customer setup where that is where the problem starts.
  
  
**Understanding of markets and of upstream and downstream impact is central to the role.**
Credit to Cash outcomes are shaped by pricing, promotions, customer agreements, invoicing, banking practice, local regulation and the retained, GBO and BPO operating model. The postholder is expected to know how these differ across LAC, NAM, Europe, Africa and APAC, to define what must be global standard and what genuinely requires localisation, and to design accordingly.
  
  
**This is a transformation design and architecture role, not an operational one.**
The postholder does not run credit, collections or cash application; that stays with market, GBO and BPO run teams. The role changes how that work is done and ensures the solution handed to run is controlled, measurable and sustainable.
  
  
The role works independently within the frame set by the workstream lead, forms its own view and brings recommendations and design decisions rather than questions. It partners closely with D&T Enterprise and Solution Architecture, which own the technical architecture, and provides functional design direction to Specialists working on Credit to Cash fragments. Decisions are expected to be based on evidence rather than opinion, and every artefact is expected to meet the programme documentation, taxonomy and quality standards, including BPQMS.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities (3-5)**
**Own the end-to-end Credit to Cash functional architecture and target design — 25%.**
Define and maintain the Credit to Cash target process and solution architecture across credit, billing hand-off, collections, cash application, deductions and disputes, AR and close, aligned to the global standard and the target operating model. Lead current-state assessment and fit-gap across markets, platforms and controls, using exception, aging, matching, collection-effectiveness and dispute data to baseline the problem and size the opportunity. Own the solution blueprint, key design decisions and design principles; define what is global standard versus market localisation; and make sure the Credit to Cash design is joined up with O2I, Claims, Commercial and Customer Service.
  
  
**Lead the HighRadius functional solution design and deployment — 25%.**
Act as functional lead for bringing HighRadius into Diageo across Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management. Design remittance capture and cash-application rules toward straight-through posting — bank, lockbox, EDI 820, email and portal remittances, matching logic, auto-match and AI-led recommendations, unapplied-cash and exception handling. Design risk-based collection strategies, segmentation, prioritised worklists, automated dunning and correspondence, promise-to-pay and dispute routing. Design credit applications, scoring models, credit-limit setting and review cycles, blocked-order release and credit workflows. Lead fit-gap, configuration design, functional specifications and sign-off with HighRadius, system integrators and D&T, and shape the multi-market deployment approach and template.
  
  
**Design integration, data and controls across the Credit to Cash landscape — 20%.**
Own the functional design of data flows and integration between HighRadius, SAP S/4HANA / ECC FSCM, banks and payment providers, ClaimOne, customer portals and the reporting layer — customer master, open items, payments, postings, disputes, credit exposure and limits. Define master-data and reference-data requirements, reason-code frameworks and posting logic. Embed financial controls, segregation of duties, audit trail and SOX / internal-control requirements in the design, and define the KPIs and reporting — DSO, CEI, overdue, auto-match rate, unapplied cash, credit-decision cycle time, exception and resolution time — that let the business manage the process in BAU.
  
  
**Deliver the outcome and assure design quality through the value drops — 20%.**
Break the architecture into fragments that can be delivered on the two to four week value drop cadence, and act as design authority on each: review requirements, specifications, configuration and test coverage produced by Specialists, integrators and vendors. Define end-to-end test scenarios, lead integrated SIT and UAT across the value chain, and own resolution of design-level defects. Support cutover, data migration, deployment, hypercare and handover into run. Monitor post-go-live performance against the baseline and drive continuous improvement in automation rates, exception volume and resolution time. This is the accountability every other accountability serves.
  
  
**Shape the roadmap and lead across the programme — 10%.**
Own the Credit to Cash functional roadmap: sequencing of modules and markets, adoption of new HighRadius and SAP capability, AI and automation opportunities, and retirement of legacy tools and manual workarounds. Act as trusted adviser to the workstream lead, market Finance, Credit and Collections leaders, GBO, D&T and vendors. Coach and guide Specialists on Credit to Cash design, and surface cross-boundary impact with Order-to-Invoice, Claims, Customer Service and Record-to-Report before it becomes a deployment defect.
  
  
**Key Competencies (3)**

* End-to-end Credit to Cash mastery and functional architecture. Expert, end-to-end knowledge of the Credit to Cash value chain — credit risk and credit management, collections and dunning, payments and cash application, deductions, claims and disputes, AR accounting, reconciliation and close — and of how each step drives the next. Able to design an integrated target process and solution architecture, run a fit-gap, make and document design decisions, and balance global standard against local need. Built on a broad understanding of Customer Operations end to end (Order to Cash, Commercial and Supply) and of how markets actually work. Knows Consumer Products industry standards and the realities of Beer, Wine & Spirits — distributor and wholesaler concentration, complex customer agreements, deduction-laden remittances, multi-currency receipts and diverse banking practice. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.
* HighRadius and SAP platform depth, integration and data. Hands-on functional depth in HighRadius Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management — configuration, matching and AI models, strategies, worklists, workflows and scoring — and in SAP FI-AR and FSCM (Credit, Collections and Dispute Management), including how the two integrate. Understands the data model, interfaces, bank formats, posting logic and controls beneath the process, and can work credibly with technical architects and integrators on integration patterns. Comfortable interrogating data directly to baseline problems and prove outcomes. Strong on solution design documentation, end-to-end testing, cutover and hypercare. Keeps up with the C2C technology market and can judge objectively where a platform fits and where it does not.
* Design authority, influence and leadership. Holds the design line with confidence and evidence — challenges solutions that would not work in the markets and is not satisfied with automating a workaround when the issue could be designed out. Strong stakeholder management and influencing across a global and local matrix, up to senior Finance and Customer Operations leaders, and with vendors and system integrators. Consultative by default: frames the problem before prescribing and drives stakeholders toward aligned decisions. Clear communicator able to explain complex design simply, manage conflict to a resolution and guide less experienced colleagues. Comfortable with ambiguity and with being redeployed across markets and workstreams. Resilient, collaborative and a visible role model for Diageo’s values.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications and Experience Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Finance, Accounting, Business, IT or a related discipline; a professional accounting or MBA qualification is an advantage.
* HighRadius certification (Cash Application, Collections or Credit) and / or SAP S/4HANA FI-AR or FSCM certification is preferred. Solution-architecture, Agile / Scrum or Lean Six Sigma credentials are an advantage. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.

**Experience — Essential**

* Overall. 12+ years in Credit to Cash / Order to Cash transformation, solution design and consultancy, including at least 5 years in a functional solution architect, solution lead or design authority role on large-scale, multi-market programmes.
* HighRadius. Functional lead or architect on at least two full-lifecycle HighRadius implementations covering Cash Application, Collections and / or Credit Management — from fit-gap and design through configuration, testing, deployment and stabilisation — ideally integrated with SAP.
* End-to-end Credit to Cash. Deep functional understanding of the whole value chain — credit, collections, cash application, deductions and disputes, AR and close — and evidence of designing across it as one solution, not only within a single module. Operational exposure is useful context; the requirement is designing the process, not running it.
* SAP and integration. Strong functional knowledge of SAP FI-AR and FSCM (Credit, Collections, Dispute Management) in S/4HANA or ECC, and experience defining functional integration with banks, lockbox / bank statement formats, EDI and third-party C2C platforms.
* Transformation. Experience in business process transformation across the full lifecycle, including current-state assessment, future-state operating model design, global template definition and multi-market rollout. Evidence of improving auto-match rates, DSO, overdue, exception volume or manual effort against a defensible baseline.
* Consultative and leadership. A track record as a trusted adviser to senior Finance and Operations stakeholders, leading design decisions across global and local teams, directing system integrators and vendors, and guiding analysts and specialists.
* Industry. FMCG or Consumer Products experience is essential. Beer, Wine & Spirits experience is strongly preferred.

**Experience — Desirable**

* Exposure to the wider HighRadius suite (Deductions, EIPP / invoice presentment, Cash Forecasting, Treasury) or to comparable C2C platforms
* Experience applying AI and machine learning in Credit to Cash — remittance capture, matching, collection prioritisation, payment prediction or credit scoring — and designing the controls around it.
* Experience designing for a retained / GBO / BPO operating model, or of a shared services transition or operating model consolidation.
* Experience with credit insurance, credit bureau and rating-agency integrations, e-invoicing and statutory requirements across multiple regions.
* Experience working in a pooled, on-demand or competency-based delivery model across multiple workstreams.

**About Us**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

The position is hosted within the Digital Technology entity of Orange Business, where we are dedicated to driving innovation and excellence in technology solutions. As part of our team of System Architects, you will lead System Architecture of our service assurance AgileReleaseTrain.
  
  

* Design the architecture of network monitoring & observability solutions in the overall Service Assurance systems landscape.
* Define standards and best practices for monitoring and observability.
* Build the architecture to automate the collection, analysis, and visualization of metrics and logs in conjunction with other systems and processes to support the Monitoring & .
* Collaborate with business teams to gather business requirements in term of (auto-)discovery, collect, alerting, correlation, AIOps, dashboard and reporting solutions.

* Must have worked with SAFe/ Agile teams and should have thorough experience of the methodologies & terminology used thereby.
* Analyze ART (Agile Release Train) performance and identify areas for improvement to enhance service delivery.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to team members.
* Share & advocate within Digital Technology, Orange Business and the wider Orange Group.

The ideal candidate will possess strong problem-solving abilities, excellent communication skills, and a collaborative mindset. You should be adaptable to changing environments, demonstrate leadership qualities, and have a proactive approach to continuous improvement.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to collaborate with international teams across various locations, including India, the UK, France, Morocco, and Egypt. This diverse environment fosters a rich exchange of ideas and perspectives, enhancing your professional experience.
  
  
**About You**
This is a senior position requiring a minimum of 15 years of experience, including at least 5 years of demonstrated success as a technical leader in Monitoring and Observability. A degree in IT Engineering is essential, and relevant certifications will be appreciated.
  
  
Your technical skills:
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Telecommunications, or related field.
* Significant experience (at least 5 years) in monitoring, observability, and SRE architecture.
* Proficiency with Splunk and BluePlanet UAA (or other industry standard monitoring and observability tools).
* Strong knowledge of cloud environments (Azure (preferred), GCP, AWS), microservices architectures, and containerization technologies (Kubernetes).
* Deep understanding of data collection and monitoring protocols.
* Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD practices.
* Strong analytical, synthesis, and communication skills.
* Innovative mindset and team-oriented approach.
* Proficient practice of SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework)
* Data collection and monitoring protocols (SNMP, NetFlow / sFlow, Syslog, REST API, Messaging bus (e.g. kafka), OpenTelemetry, etc.).

* Network services architecture (SDWAN, Cloud Connectivity, MPLS, etc.)

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.

title: Director, Integrated Modeling Solutions
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.
  
  
Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.
  
  
**a Purpose Driven Company – 150 Years**
While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.
  
  
At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.
  
  
Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Based in India, the Director, Integrated Modeling Solutions will lead the team responsible for the architecture, design, development, testing, governance, and delivery of Prudential's strategic PyVal and Eureka! modeling platforms. This role combines deep financial or actuarial modeling expertise with modern software engineering, people leadership, and disciplined execution to advance an integrated global modeling ecosystem supporting valuation, forecasting, capital management, asset liability management, reinsurance analysis, and strategic decision-making.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Set the technical direction and actionable roadmap for assigned PyVal and Eureka! capabilities, and lead the architecture, design, development, testing, and controlled deployment of scalable Python-based modeling solutions.
* Translate global priorities into a sequenced portfolio of model development, enhancement, and remediation work, managing scope, capacity, dependencies, risks, releases, and delivery commitments across concurrent initiatives.
* Maintain rigorous model governance and controls across model logic, assumptions, data lineage, documentation, testing, access, release management, validation, and production support.
* Lead, coach, and build a high-performing India-based modeling team, strengthening capability across actuarial and financial modeling, Python engineering, insurance products, governance, and stakeholder management.
* Serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders across Finance, Actuarial, Investments, Treasury, Risk, Technology, and business teams, clearly communicating model insights, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Fellowship credential from the Society of Actuaries, Institute and Faculty of Actuaries, Institute of Actuaries of India, or an equivalent recognized actuarial body.
* Ten or more years of relevant experience in actuarial modeling, financial modeling, quantitative risk, insurance finance, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated people leadership and experience leading complex model development, transformation, or platform modernization initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
* Advanced Python expertise, strong knowledge of modern software development practices for controlled financial or actuarial models, and strong executive communication and decision-making skills.

**What will set you apart?**

* Deep experience in life insurance, annuities, retirement, reinsurance, institutional products, or related insurance businesses.
* Experience with valuation, forecasting, asset liability management, capital planning, liquidity risk, stress testing, or strategic asset allocation.
* Knowledge of US GAAP, US statutory reporting, Bermuda EBS or BSCR, or comparable insurance accounting and regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with Prophet, MoSes, or comparable projection systems.
* Experience with cloud-enabled platforms, Git-based development, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment, data architecture, or Agile portfolio delivery.
* Experience building or expanding a modeling, analytics, actuarial, or finance capability within a global capability center.
* \*PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

title: Engineering Team Lead
description:
**About the Job**

The Software Engineering Lead is a hands-on subject matter expert, engineering leader and people manager responsible for a cross-functional team delivering a defined set of products and services. This role combines technical leadership, delivery ownership, and people management.

We are looking for someone who can balance hands-on technical contribution with team development, technical decision-making and end-to-end ownership of product delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Leadership & Software Development**

* Lead the design, development, enhancement and maintenance of software products, ensuring code quality, scalability, performance and reliability.
* Remain hands-on with development, debugging, code reviews and complex technical problem-solving.
* Evaluate existing software architecture, identify technical gaps and drive improvements in system design, code quality and engineering practices.
* Establish and maintain sound programming practices, coding standards, documentation and development workflows.
* Make informed technical decisions, evaluate trade-offs and adopt new technologies or approaches where they provide meaningful value.

**2. Product Delivery & Project Ownership**

* Own and oversee end-to-end product delivery across AI and web development teams, from requirement analysis and technical planning to development, testing, deployment and release.
* Translate business and product requirements into technical roadmaps, execution plans and realistic delivery milestones, managing priorities, dependencies, risks and resources effectively.
* Take accountability for delivery outcomes, proactively resolve technical and operational bottlenecks, and balance speed of execution with product quality, stability and long-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align technical decisions with business objectives, adapt to changing requirements and drive continuous improvements in product development.

**3. AI, Computer Vision & Hardware–Software Integration**

* Guide the development and integration of AI-powered features, computer vision capabilities and video analytics solutions into scalable, production-ready software products.
* Apply strong programming fundamentals and technical judgment to evaluate solutions, address complex engineering challenges and improve system performance across software and hardware environments.
* Oversee integration between AI, web applications and relevant hardware components, accounting for system-level constraints, communication interfaces, performance and reliability.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and practical engineering approaches, taking calculated risks to strengthen existing products and expand their capabilities.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **Programming fundamentals:**
  Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, design principles, debugging and problem-solving.
* **Programming languages:**
  Proficiency in C/C++, Python and familiarity with their practical applications in software development.
* **Web development:**
  Experience with Angular and full-stack development concepts, including frontend, backend, APIs, databases and system integration.
* **Software architecture:**
  Ability to design, evaluate and improve modular, maintainable and scalable software systems.
* **AI and computer vision:**
  Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and computer vision, with the ability to guide development and integration into production software.
* **Hardware–software integration:**
  Understanding of system-level interactions, hardware constraints, communication interfaces and software integration challenges.
* **Engineering practices:**
  Experience with version control, code reviews, testing, debugging, release processes and software lifecycle management.
* **Project execution:**
  Ability to estimate work, plan releases, manage dependencies, prioritize competing requirements and ensure delivery accountability.

**Must Have**

* 7+ years of relevant experience in software development, with substantial hands-on engineering experience.
* Previous experience leading, mentoring or managing a software development team, ideally including experience building or scaling a team.
* Demonstrated ownership of software products, major features, technical initiatives or end-to-end project delivery.
* Ability to make and justify technical decisions through sound engineering principles, practical experience and measurable outcomes.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams and business stakeholders.
* A growth-oriented mindset, adaptability and willingness to challenge established approaches constructively.

title: Senior Solution Lead, SAP IBP Cloud Solution
description:
The Sr. Solution lead is responsible for developing solution design and build for integrated systems within the enterprise SAP IBP Cloud solution area and corresponding set of applications. In this role the Sr. Solution lead will partner with Business Analysts and Technical Analysts to understand the overall business need, define overarching requirements and create high-level design specifications, ensuring feasibility, functionality, and integration with existing systems/platforms and develop an overarching architectural design and model that will support Stryker’s business needs. The Sr. Solution lead is responsible for verifying the detailed technical documents, validating the configuration within the assigned applications, and ensuring solutions are delivered based on the architected design.
  
  
The individual should be an expert with SAP IBP Cloud solution and it’s roadmap, that includes IBP Demand, Supply Planning, Response (Allocation) and other IBP Modules. And he/she must have 2-3 full cycle implementation experience with IBP Response solutions, including Configure-To-Order and Make-To-Stock production strategies and thorough understanding/expertise in latest SAP Release with end-to-Order to Shipment and Business Logics (i.e. ATP rules) to support order allocation.
  
  
Individual should be experienced with IBP Business Processes that connect IBP system with other systems and have good knowledge on various workstreams.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead the design, configuration, and deployment of SAP IBP solutions, delivering integrated end-to-end planning capabilities across the enterprise.
* Serve as the functional and technical subject matter expert for SAP IBP, supporting solution design, build, testing, implementation, training, and global template development.
* Drive SAP IBP initiatives across key planning areas, including S&OP, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, IBP Time Series, MRP, and Spare Parts Planning.
* Ensure all solution delivery activities align with established Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) standards, processes, and best practices.
* Review and govern business process documentation, functional and technical specifications, test strategies, and go-live readiness plans.
* Collaborate with global ERP teams, business stakeholders, IT partners, infrastructure teams, and deployment teams to deliver successful business outcomes.
* Partner with solution providers, process owners, architects, and key users to execute project deliverables and support deployment methodologies.
* Continuously optimize planning processes and system performance by identifying improvement opportunities and delivering scalable, business-aligned solutions, including support for quarterly SAP IBP releases and enhancements.

**What you need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; Master’s degree (MBA, MIS, or equivalent) preferred.
* 10-13 years of experience delivering SAP full lifecycle implementations, with a proven track record of successful project execution.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with SAP IBP and/or SAP APO, including integration across end-to-end planning and supply chain processes.
* Strong expertise in SAP IBP Cloud solutions, including configuration, business process design, and integration with procurement, inventory, sales, and related functions.
* Experience integrating SAP with SAP and non-SAP enterprise applications such as Ariba, ECC, Oracle, PRMS, MFG Pro, and other third-party systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions.
* Familiarity with ITIL, Agile methodologies, and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, with the ability to work across data, integration, security, and reporting domains.
* Demonstrated success collaborating within global, cross-functional, and matrixed organizations, ideally within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated industries.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Staff IAM Engineer
description:
**About Us**
With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.
  
  
Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.
  
  
At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.
  
  
Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.
  
  
Reports To
  
  
Senior Manager - AI & IT
  
  
What You Will Be Doing
  
  
ChargePoint is looking for a IAM Engineer to lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. This role owns cloud identity, directory services, Okta identity workflows, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML). You will define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.
  
  
You will establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows. You will build and implement Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), risk-based authentication, and Okta Identity Governance (OIG) programs. You will also scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations while maintaining reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical role. You will code, design, and implement IAM solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. You will partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.
  
  
**What You Will Bring To ChargePoint**

* Lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture, encompassing cloud identity, directory services, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML).
* Define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.
* Establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows.
* Build and implement advanced identity security controls such as Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and risk-based authentication.
* Scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations. Ensure reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
* Partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.
* Drive IAM application development: code, design, and implement solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. Deliver reliable solutions that keep engineering teams productive.
* Drive IAM projects end-to-end: take ambiguous access problems, define requirements, architect solutions, and own the rollout and operationalization — not just the design.
* Refine role design and access patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, SaaS, and internal systems — eliminate unnecessary privileges, reduce manual grants, and establish scalable baseline access.
* Run and improve user access reviews (UAR): develop, execute, and design a UAR process and solution that meets compliance requirements while improving real security signal — minimize approver burden through scoping, automation, and clear decision support.
* Identify high-risk permissions and misuse paths, build controls and mitigations, and drive adoption with partner teams to reduce risk exposure.
* Operate with strong security judgment and high signal: distinguish meaningful IAM risk from noise, gather context efficiently, and escalate with crisp rationale and actionable mitigations.
* Document and standardize the paved road: write procedures, runbooks, and automation so access decisions are consistent, scalable, and not dependent on tribal knowledge.
* Conduct Agentic AI IAM requirement analyses, architecture reviews, and security gap assessments across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, AI services, and infrastructure environments.
* Develop automation for access management and secrets lifecycle operations.
* Develop and implement security controls for AI agents, machine identities, APIs, workloads, and autonomous workflows.
* Lead enterprise Agentic AI IAM program execution across multiple workstreams.
* Establish security controls for AI agents, autonomous workflows, bots, and machine identities.
* Standardize identity governance across multi-cloud ecosystems.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 8-12 years of experience in IAM, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
* Strong experience in Agentic AI IAM architecture, identity governance, secrets management, security engineering, and enterprise IAM program delivery.
* Strong expertise in requirement gathering, current-state assessments, gap analyses, control evaluations, and target-state Agentic AI IAM security architecture design.
* Experience securing cloud-native and hybrid environments and managing hybrid cloud IAM and secrets management programs.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and machine identity security.
* Experience implementing AI/Agentic security controls and secure automation frameworks.
* Platform experience: Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Google Cloud Secrets Manager, AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, container security platforms.
* Experience with Terraform, CI/CD, and DevSecOps tooling.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CCSP. (good to have)

**Location**
Gurgaon/Bangalore, India

title: Lead, Platform Engineering
description:
The Infrastructure Engineering team is responsible for building and maintaining a self-service internal development platform that enables MongoDB engineering teams to reliably deploy and operate their own production services and products. We work with numerous engineering teams across the company to understand their infrastructure requirements and development workflows, develop broadly applicable self-service platform services and tooling, continuously monitor how platform services are being utilized, and look for ways to improve developer productivity through automation and education.
  
  
We are big open source enthusiasts and use a number of open source tools in our stack (contributing upstream whenever possible). Some of the tools we use regularly include Go, AWS, Kubernetes, Crossplane, Terraform, Helm, Drone, Prometheus, and Grafana. However, technology is nothing without a stellar team of engineers that are focused on doing high quality work and working as a team to solve complex distributed computing and platform engineering problems. This is where you come in!
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Our ideal candidate
  
  

* 2+ years of experience managing and mentoring a team of 3+ engineers
* Has 5+ years of experience owning the design and implementation of large software/infrastructure projects
* Has built and operated large-scale distributed systems in cloud providers (AWS strongly preferred)

title: BRIM Technical Architect
description: What You'll Do:Own the technical architecture of the SAP BRIM platform — how it is built, integrated, and kept scalable over time. You define how the Order-to-Cash (O2C) solution is structured technically: the billing and subscription models at implementation level, the integration architecture, the cross-module technical coherence, and the extensibility patterns that keep the platform upgrade-safe and maintainable as Criteo's monetization evolves.Beyond delivery, you are a strategic thinking partner — contributing to the definition of the future billing platform: what monetization capabilities Criteo needs to build, what the platform should become, and how technical architecture choices today shape product options tomorrow.Main missions:Own the end-to-end technical architecture across BRIM modules, ensuring cross-module coherence at implementation level (CI, SOM, CM, CC, FI-CA) within the O2C flow Define and own the billing and subscription model implementation: rating architecture, pricing and charging structures, contract and entitlement lifecycle at technical level. Own the integration architecture between BRIM, S/4HANA FI and non-SAP systems — interface contracts, data flows, error handling patterns, API and event-based integration. Ensure the platform remains extensible, upgrade-safe and Clean Core compliant — define the extensibility patterns (standard APIs, events) that govern how the ABAP Lead builds. Translate functional designs into implementable technical blueprints, surfacing constraints, trade-offs and platform limitations before build starts. Partner with the BRIM Product Lead to help defining the future billing platform vision — translating market, business and monetization evolutions into technical architecture directions and platform investment options. Tasks:Define the technical implementation of monetization models: subscription structures, rating and pricing mechanics, billing cycle architecture, revenue and collection flows at system level. Design integration patterns and interface contracts (inbound/outbound, event-driven, API-based) between BRIM and adjacent systems; own technical decisions on error handling, retry, and reconciliation. Validate technical feasibility of functional designs produced by the Solution Architect; identify cross-module technical impacts and escalate conflicts or constraints before they reach build. Define extensibility standards and Clean Core guardrails for the ABAP Lead: which enhancement frameworks to use, where custom code is justified, how extensions are structured to remain upgrade-safe. Contribute to BRIM product roadmap discussions with the Product Lead: surface technical constraints, platform opportunities and build-vs-standard trade-offs that shape future product decisions." Anticipate evolutions in Criteo's monetization model and translate them into forward-looking architecture options — new billing constructs, extensibility needs, integration patterns — before they become urgent delivery requirements. Provide technical architecture inputs to backlog refinement: effort drivers, implementation options, technical risks, dependency sequencing. Produce and maintain the BRIM technical architecture documentation: module interaction model, integration blueprint, master and transactional data architecture, key identifiers across BRIM and S/4HANA. Anticipate SAP platform evolutions (S/4HANA releases, BTP where applicable) and maintain a technical roadmap that keeps the BRIM estate extensible and forward-compatible. Lead and contribute to architecture workshops with Solution Architect, ABAP Lead and BRIM components Leads. Support delivery teams during complex build, test and hypercare phases on architecture-level technical issues. Who You Are:8+ years in SAP architecture and delivery, with deep end-to-end ownership of BRIM technical implementations. Strong cross-module expertise in SAP BRIM — with solid working knowledge of SOM, CC, CI and CM integration patterns. Proven track record designing and governing billing model architectures: subscription, rating, pricing, invoicing and collection flows at technical implementation level. Solid experience defining integration architectures between SAP BRIM / S/4HANA and cloud or non-SAP systems. Strong command of SAP extensibility frameworks (standard APIs, events) and Clean Core principles — able to set the standard others build to. Able to translate functional solution designs into technical blueprints and surface implementation constraints before they become delivery risks. Ability to think beyond delivery — engaging on product vision, monetization strategy and platform futures with business and product stakeholders, not just with engineering teams. Experience working in international, distributed and offshore environments; comfortable aligning remote technical teams to architectural decisions. Strong communication skills — able to engage both Business and Engineering stakeholders, and to make architecture trade-offs legible to non-architects. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.What We Offer:🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

title: AI & Agentic Platform Architect Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are seeking an accomplished Associate Director – AI & Agentic Platform Architect to lead the architecture, engineering and operational evolution of enterprise-scale AI platforms that drive intelligent operations and digital employee experiences.
  
  
This role spans the complete Build → Deploy → Operate → Improve lifecycle and requires deep expertise across Agentic AI, Generative AI, Enterprise Application Architecture, Data & Knowledge Platforms, Automation, Observability and AI Operations.
  
  
As a key technology leader, you will be responsible for defining the enterprise architecture strategy for AI-powered platforms, designing scalable and resilient solutions, and ensuring successful adoption and operation of AI capabilities at enterprise scale. You will work across business, engineering, architecture and operations teams to transform emerging AI technologies into secure, governed and production-ready solutions that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
Success in this role requires a proven ability to architect, build and operate secure, resilient and highly available enterprise products at scale while driving innovation, operational excellence and enterprise adoption of AI-powered solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end architecture vision, standards and technical strategy for enterprise AI and Agentic AI solutions.
