* Establish end-to-end observability across applications, infrastructure, data platforms, AI models and agent workflows.
* Drive incident management, problem management and reliability engineering practices, including root-cause analysis and prevention of recurring production issues.
* Establish operational readiness frameworks covering release governance, capacity planning, resilience validation and disaster recovery.
* Define and implement AIOps, LLMOps and AgentOps practices covering quality, performance, latency, evaluation, telemetry, failure management and cost optimization.
* Utilize operational insights to continuously improve platform architecture, engineering quality, user experience and business outcomes.
* Engage, influence and manage senior technology and business stakeholders, including CTO-level leaders, to align AI platform strategy, architecture decisions and delivery priorities with enterprise objectives.
* Lead, mentor and develop high-performing teams, providing people leadership, coaching, performance guidance and capability-building across architecture, engineering and platform functions.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Deep expertise in enterprise architecture, modern application engineering and AI platform design.
* Strong understanding of Agentic AI, Generative AI, multi-agent systems, orchestration frameworks, memory architectures, tool integration and AI evaluation methodologies.
* Proven ability to architect and operate large-scale, highly available and resilient enterprise platforms.
* Expertise in enterprise application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures and cloud-native engineering.
* Strong understanding of enterprise knowledge platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic retrieval, hybrid retrieval and knowledge graph architectures.
* Experience establishing observability, reliability engineering, AIOps, LLMOps and AgentOps practices for enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security, identity management, privacy, governance and Responsible AI principles.
* Exceptional problem-solving and systems-thinking capabilities with the ability to balance innovation, governance and operational excellence.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and executive engagement skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction, lead complex initiatives and mentor high-performing engineering teams.
* Ability to drive solutions from concept through architecture, engineering, production deployment, operations and continuous improvement.

**Ideally, you'll also**

* Bring strong hands-on experience with .NET / C# and enterprise application architecture.
* Have experience with Microsoft Agent Framework or comparable agent orchestration platforms.
* Have experience with Microsoft Foundry or comparable enterprise AI development, governance and operations platforms.
* Demonstrate experience designing and implementing multi-agent and tool-enabled AI systems.
* Possess experience with cloud-native application development, containerization and orchestration technologies.
* Have experience with enterprise data platforms, lakehouse architectures, knowledge graphs and advanced retrieval technologies.
* Demonstrate experience implementing AIOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and enterprise observability practices.
* Bring experience working within large, complex and globally distributed enterprise technology environments.

**What We Look For**
We are looking for a builder, architect and operator who understands how AI, Data, Knowledge, Applications, Integration, Automation, Security and Operations come together to form a unified enterprise platform.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a balanced combination of strategic architectural thinking, deep technical expertise and operational excellence. They understand that enterprise-scale Agentic AI requires context, identity, memory, permissions, tools, workflows, observability, evaluation, governance, resilience and human oversight to deliver trusted business outcomes.
  
  
Most importantly, we are seeking an individual who can architect, build, deploy, operate and continuously evolve secure, resilient and scalable AI platforms, while driving innovation and enabling enterprise-wide adoption of next-generation intelligent solutions.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: Lead Salesforce Engineer
description:
The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in enabling MongoDB’s post-sales business processes, including Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, and account management workflows. By leveraging Salesforce and related business systems, the team ensures that post-sales teams have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support customer outcomes, improve operational efficiency, and drive long-term customer growth.
  
  
With deep expertise in Salesforce development, platform governance, automation, integrations, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM platform to support evolving post-sales business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Customer Success, Technical Services, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Billing, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced Lead Salesforce Engineer to drive the architecture, design, and evolution of critical Salesforce and CRM solutions supporting MongoDB’s post-sales business processes. This role combines deep technical leadership, hands-on solution design, cross-functional stakeholder partnership, people management, and a modern engineering mindset that embraces AI-powered development responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and long-term platform health.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing scalable Salesforce solutions for complex customer lifecycle processes, including customer success operations, support workflows, renewals, account management, customer health, and post-sales automation.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable Salesforce solutions supporting post-sales teams, including Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, and account management workflows
* Translate business requirements into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions aligned with long-term platform strategy
* Partner closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering teams to refine requirements and deliver high-quality post-sales solutions
* Oversee integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise platforms, ensuring reliable data flow and sound system design across the customer lifecycle
* Drive platform optimization across performance, scalability, usability, maintainability, and governance
* Establish and enforce engineering standards for coding, testing, documentation, CI/CD, and release management
* Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and drive long-term, scalable resolutions
* Maintain technical documentation, including architecture decisions, design specifications, and implementation details
* Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, releases, and best practices, and proactively recommend improvements
* Proactively identify process and technical gaps, and help define and drive tech debt reduction initiatives, platform modernization efforts, and engineering efficiency improvements across the Salesforce ecosystem
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Apex Guru, GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce/Vibes, Claude Code, and similar capabilities to improve development productivity, code quality, design effectiveness, troubleshooting, and documentation, while applying strong judgment around security, privacy, accuracy, and responsible AI usage

**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices
* Act as a subject matter expert on Salesforce development, platform capabilities, automation, integrations, and scalable CRM solution design for post-sales business processes
* Lead technical design sessions and identify gaps between current-state and future-state solutions
* Design and support scalable solutions for customer success, support operations, renewals, customer health, account management, and related post-sales workflows
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices, and drive proof-of-concepts where appropriate
* Mentor engineers across the team and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence
* Support team growth by coaching, developing talent, and helping build a high-performing engineering organization
* Influence business and technical stakeholders through strong communication, sound judgment, and effective problem-solving
* Operate effectively in a fast-changing environment by managing priorities, driving accountability, and ensuring high-quality execution

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* 12+ years of experience in Salesforce engineering, application development, or technical leadership within global SaaS organizations
* Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, integrations, and Salesforce platform customization
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, design patterns, and scalable solution design
* Experience designing or supporting Salesforce solutions for post-sales functions such as Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, or customer lifecycle management
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, and Agile/Scrum delivery models
* Salesforce Platform Developer II certification required; Salesforce Certified Application Architect and Salesforce Certified System Architect certifications strongly preferred

Success Measures
  
  
In 3 months, you will
  
  
Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, post-sales business processes, and technical landscape. Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across Customer Success, Support, Revenue Operations, and Engineering.
  
  
In 6 months, you will
  
  
Lead the technical design and successful delivery of critical Salesforce initiatives supporting post-sales workflows. Establish yourself as a trusted technical leader within the Business Systems team.
  
  
In 12 months, you will
  
  
Be the go-to technical leader for Salesforce architecture, complex solution design, and platform strategy for post-sales systems. Elevate team quality through strong technical leadership, mentoring, and scalable engineering practices
  
  
**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Solution Engineering - Apps & AI
description:
**Overview**
Work with multinational enterprise customers to achieve their business goals using Azure as their platform of choice. Open doors, become a trusted technical adviser, uncover opportunities and turn their ambitions into practical solutions that deliver business value.
  
  
Combine an enterprise-architecture mindset and broad cloud understanding with strong, hands-on Apps and AI expertise. You do not need to be the deepest expert in every Azure service; know how a complete solution fits together and when to involve specialists and subject matter experts.
  
  
This role offers autonomy and influence across customer organisations. Own the technical direction of complex opportunities, align teams when priorities are unclear and take responsibility for achieving agreed technical outcomes. Work from executive conversations to practical demonstrations, challenging assumptions constructively and drawing on account teams, specialists and partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Technical Sales Leadership
  
  

* Proactively build customer access, discover unmet needs across Azure and create new technical opportunities that deliver business value.
* Independently lead complex engagements spanning multiple technologies, teams and customer locations. Align stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and drive technical decisions through discovery, workshops and demonstrations.

Application Modernization
  
  

* Help customers modernise applications using Azure and cloud-native approaches, balancing existing investments with future business needs.
* Guide modern software delivery and developer productivity, including GitHub and GitHub Copilot, to accelerate innovation.

AI & Intelligent Applications
  
  

* Shape intelligent applications and agent solutions using Microsoft Foundry, Copilot technologies and enterprise data, including Microsoft Fabric where relevant.
* Build focused prototypes and demonstrations to test customer ideas, show value and guide secure, responsible AI adoption.

Solution Design & Architecture
  
  

* Take an end-to-end view across Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, security, data, applications and AI, including hybrid environments.
* Adapt and extend architecture patterns for complex customer requirements. Make clear recommendations on trade-offs between business value, security, reliability and cost, and develop practical roadmaps rather than isolated product designs.
* Work with specialists, customer success and partners to help customers progress from architecture to adoption.

Customer & Market Engagement
  
  

* Build trusted relationships from developers and architects to Heads of Development and VPs; listen, challenge constructively and build consensus across technical and business stakeholders.
* Understand customer priorities, programmes and decision-makers, aligning technical engagement with their wider business and transformation strategy.

Sales & Business Impact
  
  

* Use business and commercial judgement to connect technical choices to customer outcomes and differentiated Microsoft value, building a clear case for investment.
* Qualify technical opportunities around clear customer needs and business value, and agree meaningful next steps.
* Shape the strategy for winning and growing opportunities with account teams, using customer and competitive insight to guide investment decisions and overcome technical barriers.

Team & Community Contribution
  
  

* Lead collaboration across teams and coach technical colleagues and account teams. Create reusable architectures and approaches from customer engagements, and help others apply them to improve outcomes beyond your own opportunities.
* Maintain hands-on learning, relevant skills and certifications, and demonstrate inclusion, integrity and customer focus.

**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
  
**Meet One Of The Following Alternatives**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience;
* OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 6+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience;
* OR 7+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience;
* OR equivalent experience.

Technical Experience
  
  

* Proven experience across technical selling and delivery, leading complex opportunities across multiple technologies and teams from discovery to practical validation. Evidence of sound architectural decisions when requirements are unclear and influence beyond your own work.
* Strong understanding of Azure, enterprise architecture and how infrastructure, security, data, applications and AI work together.
* Hands-on application development and AI capability, including building prototypes and explaining technical choices to customers.
* Experience with modern software delivery and developer productivity, using Microsoft technologies or comparable platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and commercial judgement, with the ability to work independently from practitioner to executive level and navigate ambiguity across organisational boundaries.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.
* 6+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.
* Experience with enterprise modernization, AI solutions or multinational customer engagements, including Azure, Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Fabric or GitHub.
* Relevant cloud, AI, development, architecture or security certifications.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Customers seek your advice and involve you in their technical and business priorities.
* Strong relationships reveal new technical opportunities and support customer growth.
* Complex opportunities move forward because your architecture recommendations and technical proof help customers resolve trade-offs and make confident investment decisions.
* Customers experience a coordinated Microsoft team, and colleagues reuse your architectures and approaches to achieve stronger outcomes.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: IT Engineer II, ITSE Solutions
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a highly skilled ServiceNow ITSM Solution Engineer to serve as a critical bridge between business needs and technical implementation. In this role, you will partner closely with stakeholders, product teams, and service organizations to understand complex business challenges and translate them into scalable, cost-effective ServiceNow solutions. This position plays a key role in shaping solution design, ensuring alignment with ITSM product strategies, and delivering measurable value through a customer-centric approach.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of consulting mindset, technical expertise, and business acumen—capable of gathering and prioritizing requirements, architecting tailored solutions, and producing clear, actionable design documentation. You will be responsible for guiding solution delivery from concept through implementation, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, ITIL best practices, and platform capabilities.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, the ServiceNow Solution Engineer will collaborate across cross-functional teams to drive successful project outcomes, optimize IT service workflows, and enable digital transformation. This role requires the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, while maintaining a focus on delivering intuitive, high-quality user experiences that enhance operational efficiency and long-term platform scalability.
  
  
**Key Functions**

* Requirements Engineering: Actively listening to customers to uncover, analyze, and document technical needs and pain points.
* Solution Design: Creating customized technical blueprints, architectures, and integration plans.
* Technical Consulting: Evaluating feasibility, researching best practices, and proposing cost-effective solutions.
* Product Demonstration/POC: Developing proof-of-concept models to visualize value and reduce risk for buyers.
* Documentation: Creating detailed technical specifications, proposals, and project documentation.
* Communicate with internal and external stakeholders in an open and timely manner, providing all needed information and support.
* Demonstrations & Proof of Concepts (POCs) to Minimum Viable Product (MVP): Tailoring product demos and developing POCs to demonstrate how the solution solves the client's specific problems.
* Prepares and presents comprehensive technical and administrative solutions to interpret requirements, identify alternatives, and recommendations-based experience and other findings.
* Product Feedback Loop: Working with internal product and engineering teams to relay client requirements and influence product improvements.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.
* This position will collaborate with multiple internal teams to design integrations with interfacing processes, enabling automated capabilities with procurement, finance, and third parties.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Convert business requirements into technical solutions—covering data models, workflows, integrations, and security.
* Ensure platform scalability, resilience, and compliance with security and regulatory requirements.
* Design and develop and engineer robust ServiceNow architectures aligned with business objectives and IT strategies while adhering to the product line model and SAFe Agile controls/process.
* Communication with peers and upper management, as appropriate, relative to issues, problems, and general status
* Leverage insights to advise on actionable areas for improvement or other actions to ensure operational value is maintained

**Additional/Secondary Responsibilities**

* Contributing to the development and refinement of the ITSM product line roadmap, management policies and schedules as needed for future enhancements.
* Engaging with internal and external resources to ensure clarification, changes, resolution, are addressed.
* Resolve stakeholder related issues and escalate to manager or Director of Strategy and Value Optimization as appropriate.

**Required Qualifications:**
Bachelor’s degree in IT or business equivalent
  
  
**Technical Expertise**

* Strong background in software, hardware, or systems architecture.
* Must have worked in similar environments within the last two years

**Certifications**

* ITIL Foundation
* ITSM Foundation
* ServiceNow certifications CTA, CSA; other

**Experience**

* Three or more years of experience supporting development and management of IT services relative to similar roles.
* Demonstrated capabilities with ITSM, ITIL and SAFeAgile factory models.
* Demonstrated success in large scale capability development and deployment.
* Working knowledge of ITIL and ITSM principles
* Understanding of SAFe Agile methodologies and practices, specifically within ServiceNow SPM (Service Portfolio Management) in planning and execution.
* Ability to problem solve issues to resolution
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and processes
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change
* Proficient in ITSM Foundation and experience with ServiceNow ITOM, ITSM, CMDB, KB etc.
* Microsoft Office and other productivity tools
* Global/international experience or exposure a plus

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Experience working with people and teams across various functions and regions.
* Demonstrated ability to create innovative solutions and think outside the box to solve complex and analytical problems.
* Demonstrated verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
* Highly flexible and adaptable to change

title: Product Engineer
description:
**About Chariot**

Chariot is a frontier AI research lab based in Delhi, building foundation models. We're one of the original four teams selected under the IndiaAI Mission to build models from India. We want our models to work as well in Indian languages as the best AI systems work in English.

**The Role**

You'll build and own products powered by Chariot's models, from understanding a user's problem and deciding what to build to shipping it, measuring how it performs, and improving it.

This is a hands-on engineering role across the frontend and backend. You'll work directly with users and researchers, make product and engineering decisions, and take responsibility for both the user experience and the systems behind it. Your ownership continues after launch: understanding whether people are getting value, finding where the product falls short, and deciding what to improve next.

What you'll work on

1. **Understand users and shape the product.**
   Work directly with users to understand their needs, identify problems worth solving, and decide what to build. Scope work into useful increments and make clear choices about what belongs in the first version and what can wait.
2. **Build and ship across the stack.**
   Turn ideas into working products, from interfaces and user flows to APIs and backend services. Own features through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.
3. **Measure and improve.**
   Decide what success looks like and instrument products to understand how people use them. Use usage data, feedback, and failure patterns to improve the experience and guide what you build next.
4. **Own the systems behind your products.**
   Build and operate backend services that perform reliably under real load, including APIs, queues, storage, and integrations with model inference. Improve latency, throughput, reliability, and cost as usage grows.
5. **Connect product feedback to model quality.**
   Work with researchers to understand where models succeed or fail in real use. Build evaluation tools and automated checks that measure the quality of model-powered features, catch regressions, and help guide improvements.

What we look for

* **Strong product sense.**
  You can work through an ambiguous user problem, choose what matters, and explain why. You know how to scope a first version, decide what to measure, and use evidence to improve it.
* **Extensive experience building and operating backend systems at scale.**
  You've owned production services under real load, handled failures, and made informed tradeoffs around architecture, performance, reliability, and cost.
* **Full-stack engineering ability.**

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
To realize our digital transformation, we need to transform our products, experiences, processes, technology and how we operate. Delivering our clients unrivalled experience of exceptional service, value and flexibility is part of our DNA. We are looking for people who are passionate about Agile ways of working and want to spread this approach within our teams and business processes.
  
  
As we advance our digital transformation initiatives, we are looking for a Platform Engineer to lead multiple strategic projects. This role combines technical expertise with strategic leadership to oversee the development, configuration, and maintenance of our digital products, ensuring alignment with market trends and business needs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the rollout of the Smart Booking platforms/offering to BCG offices worldwide, ensuring smooth implementation and adoption.
* Maintain and manage upgrades and enhancements to the Smart Booking platforms, ensuring their capabilities are fully leveraged within our spaces.
* Evaluate Smart Office related digital products to ensure they align with market trends and business requirements.
* Facilitate stakeholder discovery for feature definition, serving as a liaison between the IT squad and stakeholders.
* Ensure epics and user stories are prioritized, updated, and available for execution.
* Write user stories and conduct refinement sessions to ensure they meet team standards and acceptance criteria.
* Support business stakeholders in eliciting business and non-functional requirements, perform gap analysis and feasibility checks, and collaborate on comprehensive test plans.
* Provide end-user support, troubleshoot issues, and answer questions.
* Utilize tools (e.g., SaaS products, SQL, Snowflake, Alteryx, Tableau) to maintain system configurations, access data, develop logic, and analyze datasets to meet stakeholder needs.
* Leverage automation tools like Python, MS Forms, Workflows in Alteryx, and PowerShell to streamline processes and enhance operational efficiency.
* Develop and implement automation scripts and workflows to improve system operations.
* Deliver AI-augmented SaaS capabilities using LLMs and Agentic AI.
* Automate workflows with Power Automate and integrate SaaS applications, APIs, and data sources.
* Work with REST APIs and MCP servers for secure AI and enterprise integrations.
* Build dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, ServiceNow, Jira, and Trello.
* Strong teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a global team.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to listen actively and engage with stakeholders at all levels.
* Customer service orientation with a diverse group of stakeholders.
* Ability to balance customer needs with functional goals and objectives.
* Proficiency in cross-team collaboration to resolve challenges.
* Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities based on customer needs.
* Experience coordinating and implementing digital solutions in a complex organizational environment.
* Hands-on experience with SaaS applications, including system configuration and integration.
* Experience working with cloud-based software and APIs.
* Working knowledge of security, access management, and data privacy for SaaS and AI solutions.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting to ensure reliable platform operations.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a role supporting digital products, preferably in an analyst or engineering role.

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Directly interact with the Director & Chapter Lead and peers within the Product Portfolio.
* Collaborate with every member of your squad, including Product Owners, Scrum Leads, Software Engineers, and QA Engineers, as well as internal customers and technical members from other Product Portfolios.

Additional info
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Proactively monitoring and resolving issues, effectively communicating with key stakeholders and management.
* Leading with a strategic vision while managing technical challenges, ensuring detailed and effective execution.
* Identifying and solving non-routine problems independently, applying broad knowledge to troubleshoot system issues.
* Translating business needs into clear, actionable Agile user stories.
* Gaining a deep understanding of digital products to serve as a subject matter expert.
* Staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in the smart booking space to ensure our product portfolio aligns with market demands.
* Understanding IT architecture and effectively extracting and analyzing data across business systems.
* Organizing and presenting data to enable quick, informed decision-making.
* Prioritizing tasks and working independently, while communicating clearly across all levels of the organization.
* Managing multiple complex tasks with high-quality results within deadlines.
* Applying Agile methodologies and principles, including work estimation techniques.
* Quickly learning and adapting to new tools and technologies.
* Collaborating with multicultural, distributed teams across time zones and managing multiple projects concurrently.
* Stay current with trends in Smart Booking, SaaS, AI, automation, APIs, and data visualization.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Staff Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon**
is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

  

We are looking for a
**Staff Compiler Performance Engineer**
to set the technical direction for Falcon performance. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. You will decide where the next significant performance gains come from, lead the design of the optimizations that deliver them, and make sure the compiler architecture supports the product roadmap.

  

You will be the senior technical voice on a distributed team of compiler experts and a key partner for runtime, GC and product teams.

**What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**
  

  
* Define the performance strategy for Falcon: identify the largest opportunities across benchmarks and customer workloads and turn them into a technical roadmap
  
* Lead design of complex, cross cutting optimizations in the optimizer and code generator, and of the interfaces between the compiler, the runtime and the garbage collector
  
* Make architectural decisions on the Falcon optimization pipeline, compile time budget and tiering strategy
  
* Lead enablement of Falcon on new hardware platforms and new Azul products
  
* Mentor senior engineers, review critical designs and code, and set standards for performance methodology and validation
  
* Represent Azul in the LLVM community: drive upstream design discussions and contributions that benefit managed language compilers
  

  
**What You'll Bring (aka Experience, Skills)**
  

  
* 8+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers
  
* Track record of technical leadership: owning the design of major compiler components or optimization frameworks used in production
  
* Expert C++ skills and experience in large, long lived codebases
  
* Deep expertise in compiler optimization and code generation, with a clear view of the tradeoffs between peak performance, compile time, warmup and code size
  
* Expert performance analysis skills down to the microarchitecture level
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Recognized contributions to LLVM or another major compiler: code owner, maintainer or author of significant upstream work
  
* Deep experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, .NET RyuJIT or similar
  
* Experience working closely with runtime and GC teams on speculation, deoptimization and barrier design

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Role Overview

* Role: Solution & Integration Architect
* Team: Technology
* Reporting to: Global CTO
* Location: Mumbai or Delhi, India
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Experience: Typically 8–12+ years, including at least 3 years in solution architecture or a technical leadership role.

Role Purpose

The Solution & Integration Architect is responsible for designing scalable enterprise solutions and seamless integrations between a digital property decisioning platform and banks’ existing technology systems.

The role acts as a technical bridge between customers, Product, Engineering, IT Operations and leadership, ensuring that business requirements are translated into practical, secure, and buildable technical solutions. It involves hands-on API design, troubleshooting, customer engagement, and end-to-end integration delivery.

Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Architecture

* Lead technical discovery and architecture workshops with banking customers.
* Design solution architectures, application components, data flows, security, and non-functional requirements.
* Maintain architecture documentation, decision records, risks, and dependencies.
* Promote reusable solutions and minimise customer-specific development.

2. API and Integration Design

* Design and document REST APIs, webhooks, callbacks, event-driven integrations, and secure file transfers.
* Develop API specifications using OpenAPI/Swagger, including payloads, validation, error handling, versioning, retries, and idempotency.
* Define authentication, authorisation, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Work with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure API Management, Service Bus, Functions, and App Services.
* Troubleshoot integration issues using logs, API traces, and monitoring tools.

3. Requirements Definition

* Work with Product Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and customers to gather requirements.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications, API contracts, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and technical constraints.
* Support backlog refinement, estimation, prioritisation discussions, and solution feasibility assessments.

4. Customer Integration Delivery

* Act as the primary technical contact for bank integration teams and third-party vendors.
* Coordinate connectivity, certificates, whitelisting, environments, and security approvals.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect resolution, go-live, and post-launch support.
* Ensure integrations are properly documented and handed over to Support and IT Operations.

5. Security and Compliance

* Ensure designs meet banking security requirements and enterprise security standards.
* Address data protection, encryption, data residency, audit logging, and retention requirements.
* Support security assessments and compliance reviews involving RBI guidance, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, and CERT-In requirements.

6. Architecture Standards and Continuous Improvement

* Develop reusable architecture patterns, integration templates, and API standards.
* Improve onboarding efficiency across multiple banking customers.
* Capture implementation lessons and collaborate with global architecture, Product, and Engineering teams.

Essential Skills and Experience

* Enterprise solution architecture and integration design, preferably in banking or financial services.
* Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, JSON, and XML.
* OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, mutual TLS, certificates, and API security.
* Microsoft Azure integration services and API management.
* Event-driven messaging, webhooks, callbacks, batch processing, and SFTP.
* API versioning, retries, timeouts, error handling, and idempotency.
* Experience integrating with loan origination systems, loan management systems, core banking platforms, document management systems, and bank middleware.
* Understanding of banking network security, release governance, SIT, and UAT.
* Experience writing technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and technical troubleshooting skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

* .NET or Java development experience.
* Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Experience working with Indian public sector banks.
* Knowledge of Finacle, TCS BaNCS, Oracle FLEXCUBE, or similar core banking platforms.
* Familiarity with RBI regulations, data protection, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
* TOGAF or other architecture frameworks.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, and integration monitoring tools.

Key Success Metrics

Performance will be measured by:

* Quality and completeness of solution designs and API specifications.
* Clear, testable requirements with minimal engineering rework.

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
* Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
* Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
* You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

# Hiring Brief [Public]

## Infrastructure & Platform Lead

Location: On-site

Experience: 3–5 Years in one or more of:

- Infrastructure Engineering

- DevOps / Platform Engineering

- Systems Engineering

- Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)

CTC: 14 - 16 LPA

Team: Will lead 2–3 IT engineers

Reports to: CTO

## About SecNinjaz

SecNinjaz is building sovereignty-aligned cybersecurity and IT solutions designed to empower organizations with secure, resilient, and open technologies.

Our mission is to become a one-stop cyber solutions partner — architecting and delivering secure infrastructure, cybersecurity platforms, and advanced technology solutions while prioritizing open-source, sovereignty, and operational resilience.

Internally, we maintain a sophisticated infrastructure stack combining on-premise virtualization, secure networking, GPU compute, and developer platforms, enabling both product development and cybersecurity operations.

We are looking for a hands-on Infrastructure & Platform Lead who can take ownership of our internal IT and infrastructure, bring operational maturity, and build systems that scale with the company.

## Role Overview

The Infrastructure & Platform Lead will be responsible for designing, operating, and continuously improving SecNinjaz's internal infrastructure and IT environment.

This role requires a hands-on technical leader capable of managing virtualization, secure networking, identity systems, developer platforms, and security infrastructure while leading a small team of IT engineers. The candidate will also mentor junior infrastructure engineers and help establish professional operational standards.

You will ensure that our internal systems are secure, resilient, well-documented, professionally operated and compliant, forming the backbone of our cybersecurity and product engineering teams.

Candidates should demonstrate strong understanding of secure infrastructure design and operational security practices.

## Key Responsibilities

- Manage and maintain virtualization infrastructure

- Operate internal technology platforms and services

- Maintain secure networking and remote access infrastructure

- Implement monitoring, alerting, and backup systems

- Improve infrastructure documentation and operational processes

- Lead and mentor junior IT / infrastructure engineers

### Compliance & Governance

- Support and maintain organizational compliance requirements related to IT and cybersecurity

- Ensure infrastructure and systems align with defined security and compliance standards

- Assist in audits by providing required technical evidence and documentation

- Maintain proper access controls, logging, and system configurations as per compliance needs

- Continuously improve infrastructure practices to align with evolving compliance requirements

## Required Skills

Candidates should have experience with:

- Linux system administration

- virtualization platforms (Proxmox / VMware / KVM)

- networking fundamentals

- VPN technologies

- infrastructure monitoring

- backup systems

- infrastructure documentation

## Preferred Experience

Exposure to any of the following is beneficial:

- developer platforms (GitLab Premium/Ultimate)

- identity and access management systems

- containerization technologies

- infrastructure automation

- storage systems

## Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate:

- is hands-on with infrastructure technologies

- has experience managing production environments

- values documentation and structured operations

- is comfortable working in a fast-growing technical organization

Experience working with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, ISO 9001, STQC, SOC2, etc.) is a plus.

## Important Note

* This role focuses on infrastructure engineering and platform operations, and is not a helpdesk or desktop support role.

Apply on LinkedIn or email your CV to jay@secninjaz.com with details of your CV, portfolio, your specific contributions, current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period or earliest date you can join SecNinjaz.

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**

* Hands-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

**Education**

* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.

**Tii Elements**

* **Curiosity:**
  Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:**
  Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:**
  Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal & external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self-Awareness & Impact:**
  Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.
  
  
**Our Mission**
is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
  
  
  
  
**Our Values**
underpin everything we do.
  

* **Customer Centric:**
  Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:**
  We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:**
  Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action & Ownership:**
  We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:**
  We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:**
  We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

**Global Benefits**

* Remote First Culture
* Health Care Coverage\*
* Education Reimbursement\*
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Self-Care Days
* National Holidays\*
* 2 Founder Days + Juneteenth Observed
* Paid Volunteer Time\*
* Charitable contribution match\*
* Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/\*
* Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
* Parental Leave\*
* Retirement Plan with match/contribution\*

\* varies by country
  
  
**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

title: Software Architect
description:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

***Recruitment Scam Notice:***

Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

**About the role:**

Cvent is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Architect to spearhead the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) solutions across our product suite. This is an exciting opportunity to lead the charge in bringing cutting-edge AI technologies to the event industry, enhancing our platforms with capabilities that drive innovation and efficiency. With over 15 years of experience in diverse technologies, you will play a crucial role in designing and implementing AI-driven systems that align with Cvent’s architectural vision and strategic goals.

**What You Will Be Doing:**

• Lead the design, development, and delivery of AI solutions across our enterprise SaaS platforms, leveraging expertise in large language models (LLMs), agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and evaluation frameworks.

• Integrate AI capabilities into existing and new products, ensuring scalability, reliability, and high performance of AI-driven features.

• Provide technical oversight and conduct thorough analysis of AI-related requirements, ensuring optimal architectural quality and alignment with Cvent’s paved road.

• Collaborate with product, UI/UX, and project management teams to define AI solutions that meet business objectives and enhance user experience.

• Document and deliver training on AI systems, promoting re-use of AI tools and technology across the company.

• Engage with 3rd party vendors to negotiate AI features and pricing, ensuring favorable terms for Cvent.

• Contribute to the automation needed for continuous deployment of AI solutions, and build tools that enhance developer productivity.

• Act as a key contributor in defining AI best practices and standards, while providing technical guidance across various departments.

**What You Will Need for this Position:**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience in software development with a strong background in AI technologies, including LLMs, agents, RAG systems, and eval frameworks.

• Proven experience with AWS, CDK/CloudFormation, TypeScript, and Java.

• Strong coding and development skills with a broad understanding of technology, including algorithms, data structures, persistence technologies, and networks.

• Exceptional technical communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI systems to diverse audiences.

• A track record of leading by example, solving complex problems, and providing mentorship to junior developers.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

• Experience as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for AI platforms within an enterprise setting.

• Familiarity with cloud strategy and AI architecture, particularly on AWS.

• Ability to make strategic technology decisions with a long-term vision (4-10 years),specifically in AI domains.

• Experience in conducting due diligence and technical integration for AI-related mergers and acquisitions.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and gain support for AI ideas and solutions across the organization.

• Experience presenting at company-wide meetings and external conferences, serving as a technology figurehead for AI initiatives.

*Disclaimer: Beware of Recruitment Scams – Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will always come from an official ‘name@cvent.com’ email. We never request any payments or ask for sensitive personal or financial information via chat or social media platforms. For more information, please visit:
https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with standard IT security practices, including identity and access management, data protection, and encryption.
* Experience automating infrastructure provisioning, continuous integration pipelines, and container orchestration technologies.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team guides customers through the moments that matter most in their cloud journey to help businesses thrive. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. As part of an innovative team in this rapidly growing business, you will help shape the future of businesses of all sizes and use technology to connect with customers, employees, and partners.
  
  
As a Principal Enterprise Architect, you will act as a trusted domain expert bridging complex commercial direction with production-grade technical implementations. You will lead strategic relationships with executive stakeholders, advising them on how to optimize their use of cloud technology to support overarching business processes. Operating at the intersection of business strategy and software engineering, you will own the technical execution of partnerships, translate enterprise needs into architectures, and guide teams through complex digital transformations.
  
  
In this role, you will lead discovery workshops, construct business capability maps, and define long-term technical road maps. You will apply core software engineering and system design principles to modernize existing applications and architect novel, cloud-native solutions incorporating advanced artificial intelligence and agentic workflows. By overseeing system-level architecture, evaluating technical trade-offs, and establishing data governance and reliability standards, you will ensure solutions are secure, and commercially viable.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain strategic relationships with executive stakeholders to advise on technology strategy, translating ambiguous enterprise needs into structured technical road maps and solutions.
* Lead discovery workshops and business capability mapping sessions to define solution constraints, operational goals, and value-based implementation sequences.
* Oversee the design and execution of cloud-native system architectures, utilizing domain-driven design, event-driven patterns, and secure integration blueprints.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
The database market is massive (IDC estimates it to be $121B+ by 2026!) and MongoDB is at the head of its disruption. At MongoDB we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading modern data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.
  
  
MongoDB is building a world-class team in India to create tooling that helps customers migrate their data from legacy relational databases to MongoDB in real-time. As companies modernise their application and data ecosystems, they are increasingly drawn to the flexibility and scalability of the document model. The tools developed by the Data Migration team are critical in this journey, helping customers with initial data loads, and continuous data synchronization.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Staff Engineer with experience in the Java ecosystem, streaming systems, and data-intensive applications to join our team. We are building a sophisticated data migration suite using a modern technology stack, which includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Debezium. A successful candidate will be a key contributor to our backend services, collaborating closely with product management and other engineers to design and implement cutting-edge products that solve complex customer challenges.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
The ideal candidate for this role will have
  
  

* 8+ years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem
* Extensive experience with streaming data platforms such as Apache Kafka and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools like Debezium
* Extensive experience with relational data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc)
* Exposure to client-side technologies such as JavaScript and React is a plus
* Empower the engineering team with unparalleled thought leadership on emerging technologies and best practices
* Proactively engage with product leaders and senior management to align technical solutions with overarching business strategies
* Mentor and guide junior and senior engineers on best practices in data structures, algorithms, and database design
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to the overall technical direction and roadmap of the team
* Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Position Expectations
  
  

* Architectural Leadership: Drive the architectural vision and technical strategy for the data migration engine and its surrounding ecosystem. Contribute core, foundational code that solves the hardest scalability problems and sets the standard for the rest of the team
* Strategic Partnership: Partner closely with Engineering Leadership, Product Management, and Design to shape the technical roadmap. Anticipate future business needs and translate them into scalable, long-term technical initiatives
* Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Define and champion engineering best practices, patterns, and standards across multiple teams. Actively mentor Senior and Mid-level engineers, cultivating a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning

Success Measures
  
  
Within the first three months, you will have:
  
  

* Familiarise yourself with the MongoDB database and aggregation language
* Familiarise yourself with the problem space and the domain
* Set up software development infrastructure (tech stack, build tools, etc) to enable development using the relevant tech stacks
* Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews

Within six months, you will have:
  
  

* Worked on and delivered a large-scale code analysis feature in the product
* Contributed to and helped deliver a few releases of the product
* Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents

Within 12 months, you will have:
  
  

* Delivered large-scale features across our entire tech stack
* Helped recruit, interview and mentor new members of the team
* Collaborated with other teams at MongoDB

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
