 Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

**About the Role**
 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced
 **Engineering Manager** 
 who can lead and grow the Passkeys team. You will build the technology taking the world beyond passwords. Bitwarden is a credential provider across browser, desktop, and mobile, and the Passkeys team owns our implementation of WebAuthn and FIDO2 — creating and asserting credentials, integrating with each platform's credential provider APIs, and the emerging standards for moving credentials between providers so that users are never locked in.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Hire, develop, and retain a strong team of engineers
* Set and report on measurable goals and objectives for the team
* Facilitate team ceremonies including weekly syncs, backlog refinements, retrospectives, and sprint planning
* Monitor in\-flight work to identify blocked items, proactively drive resolution, and provide contextual updates outside of the team to the rest of the organization
* Own escalation and triage for production issues, community\-reported bugs, and enterprise customer escalations related to autofill behavior and desktop integrations
* Maintain a healthy, sprint\-ready backlog by prioritizing bugs and tech debt alongside feature work and ensuring all items are well\-defined with accurate descriptions, technical breakdowns, and designs prior to refinement
* Serve as the primary liaison between your engineering team and Design, Product, Architecture, and other engineering teams, fielding cross\-functional questions and maintaining alignment on priorities
* Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to synthesize requests into prioritized, actionable work
* Continuously identify friction points in team processes and develop solutions to improve efficiency, quality, and developer experience
* Create an inclusive environment where teamwork and collaboration are valued
* Conduct regular 1:1s, develop individualized performance goals and growth plans, and identify stretch opportunities to support each engineer's career progression
* Perform annual or semi\-annual performance reviews when required


**What You'll Bring**
* 10\-12 years of demonstrated experience leading engineering teams or complex cross\-functional product engineering initiatives within a software engineering organization.
* Experience working in globally distributed Product Engineering, GCC, or Center of Excellence environments along with managing distributed or cross\-regional teams, including working across time zones.
* Proven ability to successfully lead delivery across engineering organizations and influence multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Agile software development, modern engineering practices, and product delivery lifecycles.
* Experience in Engineering Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering Delivery, Product Operations, Design Program Management, or similar leadership roles.
* Ability to communicate effectively with Engineering, Product, Design, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving, prioritization, and decision\-making skills with a continuous improvement mindset.
* A coaching\-oriented leadership style with demonstrated experience developing high\-performing teams.
* Strong technical background in CI/CD, automation \& release engineering \- sufficient to engage credibly in technical discussions and step in hands\-on when necessary.
* Excellent communication skills, with experience representing a team's work to leadership and stakeholders outside the team.
* Prior experience managing or working closely with BRE, SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering teams.
* Formal management training or certifications preferred.
* Experience with specific tools like Jira, Confluence, or similar project management platforms preferred with AI tooling for development and workflow support (Claude Code or similar).


**Success in This Role**
 You'll thrive in this position if you:
   

  

* Lead through influence, collaboration, and trust.
* Bring structure without introducing unnecessary processes.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Create clarity across complex, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Enjoy building teams, developing people, and enabling engineering excellence.
* Are energized by helping establish and scale a world\-class Engineering organization.


**Why Join Us**
 This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up.
   

  

 Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
   

  

 Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization \& contribute to products used by customers around the world.
   

  

 If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast\-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

title: Technical Solution Architect
description:
**About Sriggle** 




 Founded in 2015, is a Travel Technology company with comprehensive solutions by the experienced people from the industry who understand end\-to\-end needs of the user. It provides a platform that has been evolved by understanding the best practices implemented across the globe. Sriggle has emerged significantly and marked its presence in this short span of time in the travel market. Sriggle was awarded for their voice enabled solution with Artificial Intelligence. Sriggle is an ISO 27001 certified company for their product development processes. Sriggle is a multinational company headquartered at Faridabad, India and branch/sales offices at Dubai, and London.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Design and define the overall application architecture for scalable, secure, high\-performance, and maintainable software solutions.
 



 • Lead architectural discussions, reviews, and technical decisions, aligning technical designs with business requirements and strategic goals.
 



 • Create and maintain comprehensive architecture documentation including high\-level design (HLD), low\-level design (LLD), architecture blueprints, data flow diagrams, and integration patterns.
 



 • Evaluate and recommend appropriate application frameworks, design patterns (e.g., MVC, microservices, event\-driven), programming languages, and third\-party libraries or tools.
 



 • Define and enforce coding standards, architectural best practices, and design guidelines to ensure consistency and quality across application modules.
 



 • Collaborate closely with product managers, business analysts, developers, QA, and DevOps teams to translate functional and non\-functional requirements into robust technical solutions.
 



 • Conduct code and design reviews to ensure adherence to the defined application architecture and identify potential technical risks or anti\-patterns.
 



 • Define API contracts, integration strategies, and inter\-service communication patterns (REST, Web API, message queues, etc.) across application components.
 



 • Mentor and guide developers on application design principles, architectural thinking, and best practices. • Stay current with emerging application technologies, frameworks, and industry trends, and evaluate their applicability to Sriggle's product ecosystem.
 



  





**Qualification** 




 • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
 



 • 5–9 years of overall software development experience with relevant experience in application architecture.
 



 • Proven track record of designing and delivering complex application systems from concept to production.
 



 • Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



  





**Skills** 




 •
 **C\# / .NET:** 
 C\#, .NET, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API.
 



 •
 **Database** 
 : Microsoft SQL Server, T\-SQL, Stored Procedures, Functions, Views, Indexing, Query Optimization, Database Design.
 



 •
 **Architecture:** 
 Microservices, SOA, Layered/N\-Tier, Event\-Driven, Modular Architecture.
 



 •
 **Design Principles:** 
 SOLID, DRY, Separation of Concerns, Clean Architecture, Design Patterns.
 



 •
 **API \& Integration:** 
 REST APIs, Web API, API contracts, third\-party integrations, inter\-service communication.
 



 •
 **Performance:** 
 Profiling, bottleneck identification, caching strategies, SQL optimization, and application\-level optimization.
 



 •
 **Technical Leadership:** 
 Technical reviews, code reviews, mentoring, architectural decision\-making, and stakeholder collaboration.

**Summary:**
 As a Solution Architect, a typical day involves interpreting and transforming client needs into unique and actionable solutions that align with business objectives. This role requires close collaboration with sales and delivery teams to craft strategies that not only meet client expectations but also provide a strong foundation for successful project execution. The position demands continuous engagement with various stakeholders to ensure that the proposed solutions are practical, innovative, and add significant value to the client s business case, fostering long\-term partnerships and successful outcomes.
   

  

 We are seeking a seasoned and highly experienced Senior Solution Architect to join our Technology Practice. This is a strategic, client\-facing solutioning role where the primary focus is converting sales\-qualified opportunities into well\-defined, technically sound, and commercially viable solutions. Opportunities are brought in by the Sales Team — your remit begins with validating the requirement and ends with a complete solution ready for delivery.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work in close partnership with the Sales Team to understand client needs, validate scope, and develop compelling solution proposals. This role demands exceptional communication skills, deep technical expertise across networking, cloud, and Microsoft technologies, and the ability to define resource requirements and delivery timelines with precision.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Requirement Validation \& Sales Collaboration


 Receive sales\-qualified opportunities from the Sales Team and conduct thorough validation of client requirements, scope, and technical feasibility.
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales Team to clarify ambiguities, fill gaps in the brief, and ensure a clear understanding of the client's business and technical needs before solutioning begins.
   

  

 Act as the key liaison between the Sales Team and the technical practice — ensuring alignment on scope, timelines, and commercial expectations throughout the engagement.
   

  

* Client Engagement \& Advisory


 Lead client\-facing conversations to probe, validate, and refine requirements in collaboration with the Sales Team.
   

  

 Build credibility with client stakeholders as a trusted technical advisor, articulating solution value clearly at both technical and business levels.
   

  

 Present solution proposals, architecture blueprints, and delivery roadmaps with confidence to client and internal stakeholders.
   

  

* Solutioning \& Architecture


 Design end\-to\-end technical solutions across SD\-WAN, networking, Network Security, Microsoft Product Suite, and Cloud Implementation Services based on validated requirements.
   

  

 Define resource requirements and effort estimates — specifying the number of resources and number of days required for delivery.
   

  

 Develop high\-level and detailed architecture documentation, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and technical proposals.
   

  

 Ensure proposed solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with client business objectives and industry best practices.
   

  

* Internal Coordination \& Stakeholder Management


 Coordinate internally with delivery leads, engineers, project managers, vendors, and practice leads to validate and refine solutions prior to submission.
   

  

 Serve as the bridge between the Sales Team and delivery, ensuring a seamless handover with complete solution documentation and knowledge transfer post\-award.
   

  

 Engage with vendor and partner ecosystems (e.g., Microsoft, Cisco, AWS/Azure) to leverage technical and commercial support during the solutioning process.
   

  

**Professional \& Technical Skills:**
 Required Technical Expertise \-
   

  

* SD\-WAN \& Networking


 Hands\-on experience designing and architecting SD\-WAN solutions (e.g., Cisco Meraki, Fortinet, VMware VeloCloud, or equivalent).
   

  

 Strong grounding in enterprise networking — routing, switching, firewalls, MPLS, BGP, and network segmentation.
   

  

 Experience with network transformation projects, including migration from legacy WAN to SD\-WAN environments.
   

  

* Microsoft Product Suite


 Deep expertise across Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory, Intune, Teams, SharePoint, and related productivity and security toolsets.
   

  

 Familiarity with Microsoft licensing models and their commercial implications in solution design.
   

  

 Experience with Microsoft security frameworks including Defender, Sentinel, and Zero Trust architecture principles.
   

  

* Cloud Implementation Services


 Proven experience architecting cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure and/or AWS — including IaaS, PaaS, hybrid cloud, and cloud migration projects.
   

  

 Understanding of cloud governance, cost optimisation, and security best practices in enterprise environments.
   

  

 Ability to size and scope cloud engagements, including resource and effort estimation for delivery.
   

  

**Additional Information:**
* Demonstrated track record of designing and delivering complex, multi\-technology solutions in client\-facing solutioning roles.
* Experience working alongside Sales Teams — translating sales\-qualified opportunities into complete, delivery\-ready solution proposals.
* Strong commercial acumen — experience building resource plans, effort estimates, and solution costings.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills ability to present confidently to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Relevant certifications highly regarded: CCNP/CCIE, Microsoft Azure/M365 certifications, AWS Solutions Architect, TOGAF or equivalent.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).


 You Excel At
   

  

 Leading complex client conversations with confidence
   

  

 Translating business problems into technical solutions
   

  

 Navigating ambiguity and driving clarity
   

  

 Collaborating across technical and commercial teams
   

  

 You Are Known For
   

  

 Executive presence and polished communication
   

  

 Attention to detail in solution documentation
   

  

 Ownership mentality — end to end
   

  

 A collaborative, low\-ego approach
   

  

 The candidate should have minimum 12 years of experience in Network Architecture and Design.
   

  

* This position is based at our Pune office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

3. Certifications (Desirable): Cloud/architecture professional (AWS/Azure/GCP), TOGAF, or programme\-management certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe)



**Experience** 



1. 15\+ years of experience in software engineering, platform, or product engineering, with a substantial record of senior technical and organisational leadership
2. Proven experience leading the design, delivery, and operation of large\-scale, high\-availability software platforms in production
3. Extensive people\-leadership experience, having led multi\-disciplinary engineering organisations, including engineering managers and technical leads
4. Track record of delivering large, multi\-workstream technology programmes to schedule and budget, with accountability for outcomes, quality, reliability, and cost
5. Demonstrated experience owning technology strategy and architecture for an enterprise or platform operating at scale
6. Experience building and scaling high\-performing engineering teams, including talent acquisition, capability development, and the management of delivery partners and vendors
7. Strong, current technical grounding in modern software architecture and engineering practice, with the standing to set technical direction and make architecture decisions
8. Prior Government/PSU experience is not essential; the ability to operate within public\-sector requirements for data protection, sovereign infrastructure, procurement, and audit is expected



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Programme Leadership \& Strategy** 



1. Set the vision, strategy, and delivery roadmap for engineering services across Digital India platforms and cross\-ministerial systems
2. Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the programme’s portfolio of engineering initiatives across the capability teams, ensuring timely, high\-quality, and measurable outcomes
3. Establish and run programme governance — planning, prioritisation, risk management, and delivery reporting — and present progress and outcomes to NeGD leadership
4. Own the programme budget and cost governance, ensuring efficient use of infrastructure, tooling, and manpower against the approved envelope



**Technical \& Architectural Direction** 



1. Own the engineering technical strategy and target\-state architecture across capability teams — Platform Engineering; Application Development; API \& Integration Services; Data \& Analytics Engineering; DevOps \& Site Reliability; and Quality Engineering
2. Set standards for technology selection and build\-versus\-buy decisions, including the use of open\-source components, cloud\-native services, and sovereign infrastructure
3. Act as the design authority for the programme, approving reference architectures, integration standards, engineering frameworks, and deployment patterns
4. Ensure reusable engineering components — APIs, SDKs, shared libraries, and templates — are produced to a common standard and published for cross\-ministry reuse



**Organisation \& Delivery** 



1. Mentor the engineering teams and the capability\-pod leadership, scaling the organisation in line with validated demand
2. Direct and coordinate the programme’s functional and technical resources as a single, integrated delivery organisation
3. Establish the operating model, engineering standards, and delivery culture for a fast\-growing national engineering capability
4. Establish DevOps/SRE practices — CI/CD, release management, monitoring for reliability and performance, and cost\-effective operations at production scale



**Empanelment, Procurement \& Partnerships** 



1. Govern the engagement of empanelled agencies at the discovered L1 rate card across resource, project, and turnkey modes — including agency selection, performance management, acceptance, and service levels
2. Manage relationships with technology, cloud, and infrastructure providers, including commercial terms, performance, and risk



**Governance, Security \& Compliance** 



1. Ensure all engineering systems are delivered in line with applicable governance frameworks — risk assessment, change management, quality assurance, and audit
2. Ensure security and data protection by design across the programme, in line with MeitY security standards, CERT\-In directions, and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
3. Ensure the appropriate use of sovereign infrastructure and coordinate with other MeitY agencies where relevant



**Technical Competencies** 



1. **Software Engineering \& Architecture:** 
 Strong command of modern software engineering — distributed systems, microservices, event\-driven architecture, and full\-stack application development
2. **DevOps \& Site Reliability Engineering:** 
 CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, release management, monitoring, and reliable production operations at scale
3. **Solution \& Platform Architecture:** 
 Microservices, event\-driven and API\-based design, service gateways, and multi\-cloud, on\-premise, and sovereign deployment patterns
4. **Quality Engineering \& Testing:** 
 Automated testing frameworks, performance testing, and quality assurance practices across the software development lifecycle
5. **Cloud \& Infrastructure:** 
 Cloud architecture, identity and access management, scalability and reliability, and observability
6. **Cost Governance:** 
 Unit economics and cost management for compute, storage, and infrastructure, and forecasting against a programme budget
7. **Programme \& Delivery Management:** 
 Programme governance, portfolio prioritisation, budgeting, risk management, and multi\-workstream delivery
8. **Security, Data Protection \& Compliance:** 
 Access control, encryption, audit, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, CERT\-In directions, and MeitY security standards
9. **Organisational Leadership:** 
 Organisation design, hiring and capability development, performance management, and the management of delivery partners and vendors
10. **Communication \& Stakeholder Engagement:** 
 Executive communication of strategy, progress, and risk; leading technical reviews; and building alignment across technical and functional teams

title: Lead Architect
description:
We are seeking a talented and experienced Technical Architect to join our team who can play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our digital landscape. This is the place for you if the scale challenges and excites you.
 



  





 You will be responsible for designing, building, and implementing robust and scalable solutions that solve complex business challenges. You will work closely with various stakeholders, including business leaders, developers, and other architects, to translate strategic goals into technical roadmaps and executable solutions.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities:** 



* **Challenge Resolution:** 
 Leverage your proven track record to identify and resolve critical technical challenges with innovative and effective solutions. Prioritize collaborating directly with key stakeholders to develop long\-term strategies instead of resorting to temporary workarounds.
* **Technical Expertise:** 
 Possess hands\-on experience in modern technologies like Java (Spring Boot), Node.js (Express.js), and a UI framework like React.js or Vue.js. Proficiency in utilizing messaging brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and streaming processing technologies (Apache Spark) is highly desirable.
* **Database Mastery:** 
 Demonstrate in\-depth knowledge of diverse databases including Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, along with expertise in NoSQL options like MongoDB, Cassandra, and Couchbase. Entity modeling proficiency is essential.
* **Architectural Acumen:** 
 Possess proven experience in architecting solutions across all layers, including technical, integration, data, and application architecture. Your experience should encompass multi\-country implementations and collaboration with geographically dispersed teams.
* **Hybrid Expertise:** 
 Architect and design solutions that seamlessly integrate legacy COTS and homegrown applications with modern microservices, utilizing open\-source technologies.
* **Innovation Champion:** 
 Lead the development and implementation of technology prototypes, proof of concepts, and reference implementations for exploring new technologies and staying ahead of the curve.
* **Containerization Savvy:** 
 Hands\-on experience architecting, designing, and implementing microservices solutions leveraging container\-based technologies like Docker, Swarm, Compose, and Kubernetes.
* **Strategic Vision:** 
 Demonstrate strong strategic thinking abilities and an enterprise\-wide perspective, ensuring your solutions align with business objectives and long\-term goals.
* **Execution Excellence:** 
 Set ambitious yet achievable goals and meticulously execute on them through well\-defined plans and actions. Effectively manage competing priorities without compromising delivery timelines.
* **Influential Leadership:** 
 Lead through influence and build strong relationships with diverse stakeholders in a complex, global environment.
* **Communication \& Collaboration:** 
 Possess outstanding communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and negotiation skills.



  





**Preferred Skills:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (Master's degree preferred).
* Minimum of
 **10\-15 years** 
 of experience as a Digital Architect or similar role.
* Proven track record of successful project delivery within complex and demanding environments.
* Strong understanding of contemporary digital technologies and platforms including UX, APIs, Microservices, Analytics, and SaaS.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.



  





**What you get:** 



* Chance to work in a truly agile Organization.
* Chance to very closely work on very High Scale Telecom Applications
* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge projects and technologies
* Collaborative and supportive work environment
* Career growth and development opportunities

title: PLM AI System Architect
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 We are seeking a visionary
 **PLM AI System Architect** 
 to lead the digital transformation of our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of deep engineering domain expertise and cutting\-edge Generative AI. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and scaling agentic AI capabilities that transform how we manage requirements, BOMs, CAD/CAM data, and service lifecycles. The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between our PLM platforms, engineering stakeholders, and enterprise AI architecture.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Strategic PLM Leadership: Drive AI adoption across the entire product lifecycle—from requirements and EBOM/MBOM management to digital twin enablement.
* Agentic AI Engineering: Design and orchestrate multi\-agent systems capable of reasoning over complex PLM data, automating classification, and performing automated change impact analysis.
* Advanced Data Retrieval (RAG): Architect RAG pipelines that ensure engineering\-grade accuracy, specifically tuned for structured PLM data and unstructured technical documentation.
* Architect and configure AI\-powered retrieval systems that handle both structured PLM data (attributes, relations) and unstructured content (specifications, PDFs, drawings).
* AI Integration Architecture: Lead the development of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and secure integration layers to expose PLM services to enterprise AI agents.
* Governance \& Scaling: Define the AI maturity roadmap, ensuring all deployments meet strict enterprise standards for data privacy, IP protection, and cost governance.


**What You Bring**
* Required total 7\+ years of experience along with relevant experience 3 years in Artificial Intelligence.
* PLM Domain Expertise: Basic understanding of PLM (Product Lifecycle Management).
* AI \& Intelligent Systems: Proven expertise in Agentic AI frameworks, RAG architectures, and tool\-calling patterns. Strong grasp of grounding strategies to mitigate hallucination risks in technical environments.
* Platform \& Integration: Experience building AI integration layers (e.g., MCP servers), managing APIs/microservices, and deploying AI services in cloud\-native environments.
* Communication: Ability to distill complex technical architecture into actionable business value narratives for senior leadership.
* Business Impact: Quantifiable reduction in cycle time and manual effort through AI automation.
* System Integrity: High accuracy and "trust scores" for AI\-generated engineering outputs.
* Scalability: Successful deployment of reusable AI architectural patterns across the broader enterprise.


**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90\+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than 92,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making balanced, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 "Let’s make tomorrow different today" is our genuine dedication at Siemens Energy to all customers and employees on the way to a balanced future.

 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

 As a Solution Architect, you’ll be architecting customer centric, high performance, secure and robust end to end digital products, solutions, and services that deliver business value while aligning to the bank’s strategic target architectures and roadmaps.

title: Server Performance Architect - Hardware
description:
Job Requisition ID JR2016230
   

  

 Job Category Engineering
   

  

 Time Type Full time
   

  

 NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
   

  

 NVIDIA is seeking architects to drive architectural performance for its next\-generation AI server systems. This position demands a unique capability to bridge deep architectural knowledge, workload analysis, and hands\-on silicon investigations. Candidates should be adept at working directly with silicon, high\-level models, and simulators. Responsibilities include conducting performance investigations on both NVIDIA and competitive platforms, and developing targeted microbenchmarks to examine specific architectural aspects. The role does not heavily involve modeling tasks (functional or performance), though occasional focused assignments may arise.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Defining and driving server\-level performance targets across CPU, GPU, memory, interconnect, networking, and storage subsystems
* Conducting hands\-on workload characterisation and bottleneck analysis on NVIDIA and competitive server platforms using AI training, inference, and HPC benchmarks
* Leveraging profiling, tracing, and analysis tools to root\-cause performance issues and identify optimisation opportunities at the system level
* Performing trade\-off studies on system topology, thermal/power envelopes, and memory hierarchy to guide architectural decisions
* Collaborating with silicon, platform, firmware, and software teams to identify and close performance gaps from bring\-up through production
* Developing automation and tooling for performance regression tracking and reporting
* Representing the performance perspective in architecture reviews and cross\-functional design discussions
* Building and maintaining analytical performance models and simulation frameworks for next\-generation server platforms
* Publishing internal performance studies and best\-practice guides for partner and customer enablement


**What We Need To See**
* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
* 10\+ years of experience in server/system performance architecture or related disciplines
* Deep understanding of modern server architectures — CPU microarchitecture, PCIe/CXL, DDR/HBM memory subsystems, and coherency protocols
* Strong hands\-on experience with system\-level profiling and performance analysis tools on server platform(s)
* Solid knowledge of GPU\-accelerated compute, high\-performance networking, or high\-performance storage subsystems
* Proficiency in Python, C/C\+\+, or similar languages for scripting, data analysis, and tool development
* Comfortable and proficient using AI\-powered coding and productivity tools to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation workflows
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to distil complex performance data into actionable architectural recommendations

The company provides comprehensive solutions including intelligence, fraud investigation, security assessments, risk management, and compliance support. Its portfolio spans risk and assurance, cyber and resilience, business assurance as a service, and education programs such as cybersecurity courses and cyber ranges. Combining industry expertise with modern research methodologies, UniSense delivers practical, forward\-looking strategies that help organizations safeguard digital assets and maintain operational continuity. The firm emphasizes a holistic, client\-focused approach to addressing complex cyber risks and strengthening overall security posture.
 



**Role Description** 
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Technical Architect** 
 specializing in
 **Salesforce Field Service (SFS)** 
 to lead the design, delivery, and continuous evolution of field service solutions for our managed services clients. This role blends deep technical architecture expertise with strong client\-facing and stakeholder management skills. The ideal candidate will act as the trusted technical advisor for a portfolio of clients — translating business requirements into scalable, well\-governed Salesforce solutions while overseeing ongoing support, enhancements, and platform health within a managed services model.
 



 This is a senior, solution\-focused role for someone who is equally comfortable designing complex technical architectures, leading solution workshops, mentoring delivery teams, and managing executive\-level client relationships.
 







**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Solution Architecture \& Technical Design** 



* Architect end\-to\-end Salesforce Field Service solutions, including Service Cloud, Field Service Lightning (FSL), scheduling optimization, mobile workforce enablement, and integrations with ERP, IoT, asset management, and inventory systems.
* Design scalable data models, sharing/security architecture, and integration patterns (REST/SOAP APIs, MuleSoft, middleware) that align with enterprise architecture standards.
* Own the technical solution blueprint from discovery through go\-live, ensuring designs are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with Salesforce best practices and the Well\-Architected framework.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical health checks, and org optimization assessments for existing managed services clients.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate Salesforce products/features (Field Service, Omni\-Studio, Experience Cloud, Einstein/Agentforce, CTI) to meet evolving business needs.
* Define and enforce coding standards, DevOps/release management practices, and technical governance across the managed services portfolio.



**2\. Managed Services Delivery** 



* Serve as the lead technical authority for a portfolio of managed services accounts, ensuring platform stability, performance, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee triage, root\-cause analysis, and resolution of complex technical issues escalated from support teams.
* Drive proactive roadmap planning, release management, and quarterly enhancement planning with clients.
* Manage technical debt, org complexity, and platform scalability over the lifecycle of the managed services engagement.
* Partner with project/delivery managers to scope change requests, estimate effort, and manage sprint/release backlogs.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, quality standards, and managed services governance frameworks.



**3\. Stakeholder \& Client Management** 



* Act as the primary technical point of contact and trusted advisor for client stakeholders, from business users to C\-suite/IT leadership.
* Lead solution design workshops, technical discovery sessions, and architecture review boards with client teams.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear, business\-relevant language for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Manage client expectations around scope, feasibility, timelines, and technical trade\-offs.
* Build long\-term, consultative relationships that support account growth, renewals, and expansion of managed services scope.
* Present technical roadmaps, health assessments, and strategic recommendations in client governance meetings (QBRs, steering committees).



**4\. Team Leadership \& Enablement** 



* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to developers, consultants, and administrators within the delivery team.
* Review solution designs, code, and configurations produced by the team to ensure quality and adherence to standards.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including solution scoping, effort estimation, and technical proposal development (SOWs, RFP responses).
* Contribute to internal capability building, reusable assets, accelerators, and best\-practice documentation for Field Service engagements.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7\+ years of Salesforce implementation experience, with at least 3–4 years focused specifically on
 **Salesforce Field Service (FSL)** 
 .
* Proven experience working in a
 **managed services / support\-and\-enhancement** 
 delivery model (not just greenfield implementations).
* Demonstrated experience as a Technical or Solution Architect, owning end\-to\-end solution design and delivery oversight.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of:
* Field Service core objects (Work Orders, Service Appointments, Resources, Skills, Scheduling Policies, Service Territories)
* Scheduling \& Optimization (complex scheduling policies, Optimization, Dispatcher Console)
* Salesforce Field Service mobile app configuration and customization
* Service Cloud (Omni\-Channel, Case Management, Entitlements/SLAs)
* Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, and declarative automation
* Integration technologies (REST/SOAP, MuleSoft, Platform Events, middleware tools)
* Data modeling, security architecture, and sharing rules at enterprise scale
* Experience managing multiple concurrent client engagements or accounts.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies and DevOps/release management tools (Copado, Gearset, Flosum, or similar).



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Salesforce certifications:
 **Field Service Consultant** 
 ,
 **Application Architect** 
 or
 **System Architect** 
 ,
 **Sharing and Visibility Architect** 
 ,
 **Integration Architect** 
 , Platform Developer II.
* Experience with adjacent technologies: MuleSoft, Tableau/CRM Analytics, IoT integrations, asset/inventory management systems.
* Prior consulting or systems integrator (SI) background.
* Experience in industries with heavy field operations (utilities, telecommunications, manufacturing, healthcare equipment, energy).
* Familiarity with Salesforce Well\-Architected principles and Success Cadence / Signature Success programs.
* Experience contributing to pre\-sales, SOW development, or proposal writing.







**Key Competencies** 




**Solution Architecture** 




 Ability to design scalable, secure, maintainable Salesforce solutions aligned to business outcomes.
 



**Client Advisory** 




 Comfortable operating as a trusted advisor across business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
 



**Technical Leadership** 




 Guides and mentors delivery teams, sets technical direction, and ensures quality standards.
 



**Problem Solving** 




 Diagnoses complex, ambiguous technical issues and drives them to resolution under managed services SLAs.
 



**Communication** 




 Translates technical complexity into business value; strong written and verbal communication.
 



**Commercial Awareness** 




 Understands managed services commercial models, scope management, and account growth opportunities.
 







**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 



* Client platforms are stable, scalable, and continuously improved under the managed services engagement.
* Clients view the Technical Architect as a strategic, trusted advisor — not just a support resource.
* Solutions delivered are well\-architected, reusable, and reduce long\-term technical debt.
* Delivery teams are enabled and mentored to deliver high\-quality work independently.
* Managed services accounts grow in scope and value over time due to proactive technical guidance.

description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a
 **Great Place to Work** 
 ® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job?
   

  

 The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

**About The Role \& Team**
 The AI Tech Lead will establish and lead SITA for Aircraft's AI capability by building a high\-performing team, delivering practical AI solutions, and driving AI adoption across the organization.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership role combining technical expertise, people leadership, and business engagement. The successful candidate will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to identify high\-value AI opportunities and convert them into scalable, production\-ready solutions that deliver measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, and automation.
   

  

 As a key leader in the technology organization, you will drive the development of AI agents, copilots, automation solutions, and reusable AI capabilities while ensuring solutions meet enterprise standards for security, governance, reliability, and operational readiness.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 AI Delivery \& Adoption
   

  

* Partner with business teams to identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases with clear business value.
* Lead the design, development, and implementation of AI agents, copilots, and automation solutions.
* Drive successful adoption of AI solutions across teams and functions.
* Track and communicate AI usage, adoption, productivity gains, and business outcomes.
* Promote successful AI implementations and encourage reuse across the organization.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Remain hands\-on with AI technologies and contribute directly to solution architecture and development.
* Guide the team in building, testing, deploying, monitoring, and operating AI solutions.
* Support the resolution of complex technical and production issues.
* Establish engineering best practices for AI development, deployment, monitoring, and support.
* Create reusable AI frameworks, components, and accelerators that can be leveraged across multiple initiatives.


 Team Leadership
   

  

* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing AI engineering team.
* Mentor, coach, and support the growth of team members.
* Define required skills, capabilities, and development plans for AI practitioners.
* Foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, innovation, experimentation, and delivery.
* Encourage end\-to\-end accountability for AI solutions and business outcomes.


 Governance \& Operations
   

  

* Collaborate with Architecture, Security, Data, Platform, and Governance teams to enable responsible AI adoption.

title: Solution Architect - AI, Cross Industries
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next phase of AI adoption and is seeking a hands\-on AI Solution Architect (SA). AWS Solutions Architect \- AI are SA's with deep domain\-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs.
   

  

 As part of the AWS sales organization, SAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert\-level knowledge to solve. SAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud\-based system.
   

  

 SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
   

  

 This role focuses on converting Customers AI ambition into reality
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* The AI SA builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.
* You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their challenging GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
* Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.
* In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define cloud\-native GenAI/ML and Agentic architectural patterns for a variety of use cases.
* You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship: Lead hands\-on deep dives and technical workshops, contributing reusable code, reference architectures, and internal technical assets for the broader Solution Architecture organization.


 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect\-AI team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement GenAI/AgenticSolutions . In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Cross Industries work hand in hand with AWS customers across mutliple verticals like Auto/Manu, Retail/CPG, HCLS, Travel/Hospitality to help drive AWS GenAI/Agentic services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of GenAI/Agentic AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to some of the largest Brands/Services/Ecommerce customers in India . This customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 5\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer\-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* 5\+ years of management of technical, enterprise customer facing resources or equivalent experience
* Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Hands\-on experience with AWS ecosystems (including Bedrock, AgentCore, and SageMaker) to set up secure, private\-network AI environments, and practical experience implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation using embeddings, vector stores, and semantic search optimization.
* 6\+ years of design/implementation of production AI systems


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering)
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
* Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering), or Bachelor's degree
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
* Proven ability to lead projects with complex challenges with extensible, operationally excellent, cost optimized, and aligned solutions outcomes
* Expertise in architecting AI systems within highly regulated or security\-sensitive environments (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare, Public Sector).


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Solution Architect, AGS-APJ-India-ISV-SA
description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, your technical depth, business aptitude, and ability to steer technology discussions at all levels will enable you to shape the customer journey. Your thought leadership, ability to look beyond the technology, and more holistically at the value technology creates for our customers, is crucial to your success.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers, AWS and partners, and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. You will go beyond the technical solution architecture, work with partners, sellers and specialists to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.
   

  

**About The Team**
 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India, working with the customers to help drive AWS services adoption.
   

  

**About AWS**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 2\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working within software development or Internet\-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective
